title: Song of Solomon 4:9
text: You have ravished My heart, My sister, [My] spouse; you have ravished My heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.

title: Song of Solomon 4:10
text: How fair is your love, My sister, [My] spouse! How [much] better [are] your loves than wine, and the smell of your ointments than all spices!

title: Song of Solomon 4:11
text: Your lips, [My] spouse, drop like the honeycomb; honey and milk [are] under your tongue; and the smell of your garments [is] like the smell of Lebanon.

title: Song of Solomon 4:12
text: A locked garden [is] My sister, [My] spouse; a rock heap locked up, a fountain sealed.

title: Song of Solomon 4:13
text: Your plants [are] an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; with henna [and] spikenard,

title: Song of Solomon 4:14
text: spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices;

title: Song of Solomon 4:15
text: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.

title: Song of Solomon 4:16
text: Awake, O north [wind]; and come, south [wind]; blow on my garden, so [that] the spices of it may flow out. Let my Beloved come into His garden and eat His pleasant fruits.

title: Song of Solomon 5:1
text: I have come into My garden, My sister, [My] spouse; I have gathered My myrrh with My spice; I have eaten My honeycomb with My honey; I have drunk My wine with My milk. Eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O Beloved.

title: Song of Solomon 5:2
text: I sleep, but my heart is awake. [It is] the sound of my Beloved that knocks, [saying], Open to Me, My sister, My love, My dove, My undefiled; for My head is filled with dew, My locks with the drops of the night.

title: Song of Solomon 5:3
text: I have put off My coat; How shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?

title: Song of Solomon 5:4
text: My Beloved put in His hand by the hole [of the door], and my heart was moved for Him.

title: Song of Solomon 5:5
text: I rose up to open to my Beloved; and my hands dripped [with] myrrh, and my fingers flowing [with] myrrh on the handles of the bolt.

title: Song of Solomon 5:6
text: I opened to my Beloved, but my Beloved had left. He passed on. My soul went out when He spoke; I sought Him, but I could not find Him. I called Him, but He did not answer me.

title: Song of Solomon 5:7
text: The watchmen who went about the city found me [and] struck me; they wounded me. The keepers of the wall lifted my veil from me.

title: Song of Solomon 5:8
text: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if you find my Beloved, what do you tell Him? That I [am] sick [with] love.

title: Song of Solomon 5:9
text: What [is] your Beloved more than [another] beloved, most beautiful among women? What [is] your Beloved more than [another] beloved, that you adjure us so?

title: Song of Solomon 5:10
text: My Beloved [is] bright and ruddy, standing out among ten thousand.

title: Song of Solomon 5:11
text: His head [is like] refined gold; His locks [are] bushy, black as a raven.

title: Song of Solomon 5:12
text: His eyes [are] as doves' [eyes] on the rivers of waters, washed with milk, sitting on a setting.

title: Song of Solomon 5:13
text: His cheeks [are] like a bed of spices, a raised bed of aromatic herbs. His lips [are as] lilies dropping flowing myrrh.

title: Song of Solomon 5:14
text: His hands [are like] rings of gold filled with jewels; His body an ivory plate overlaid with sapphires.

title: Song of Solomon 5:15
text: His legs [are like] pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold; His face [is like] Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

title: Song of Solomon 5:16
text: His mouth [is] most sweet; yes, He [is] altogether lovely. This [is] my Beloved, and this [is] my Friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.

title: Song of Solomon 6:1
text: Where has your Beloved gone, most beautiful among women? Where has your Beloved turned? For we seek Him along with you.

title: Song of Solomon 6:2
text: My Beloved has gone down to His garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens and to gather lilies.

title: Song of Solomon 6:3
text: I [am] my Beloved's, and my Beloved [is] mine; He feeds among the lilies.

title: Song of Solomon 6:4
text: O my love, you [are] as beautiful as Tirzah, as lovely as Jerusalem, as inspiring as an army with banners.

title: Song of Solomon 6:5
text: Turn away your eyes from Me, for they have overcome Me; your hair [is] like a flock of goats that appears from Gilead.

title: Song of Solomon 6:6
text: Your teeth [are] like a flock of ewes which go up from the washing; they all [are] bearing twins, and a barren one [is] not among them.

title: Song of Solomon 6:7
text: Your temples behind your veil [are] like a piece of pomegranate.

title: Song of Solomon 6:8
text: There [are] sixty queens, and eighty concubines, and virgins without number.

title: Song of Solomon 6:9
text: But My dove, My undefiled is one [alone]. She [is] the [only] one of her mother. She [is] the choice of her who bore her. The daughters saw [her] and blessed her; the queens and the concubines saw her, and they praised her.

title: Song of Solomon 6:10
text: Who [is] she who looks forth like the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, awesome [armies] with banners?

title: Song of Solomon 6:11
text: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the greenery of the valley, to see whether the vine flowered [and] the pomegranates budded.

title: Song of Solomon 6:12
text: I did not know, [but] my soul set me [on] the chariots of my princely people.

title: Song of Solomon 6:13
text: Return, return, O Shulamite! Return, return, that we may look on you. What will you see in the Shulamite? As it were the dance of two camps.

title: Song of Solomon 7:1
text: How beautiful [are] your feet in sandals, O prince's daughter! The curves of your thighs [are] like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.

title: Song of Solomon 7:2
text: Your navel [is like] a round goblet, which never lacks mixed wine; your belly [is like] a heap of wheat set about with lilies.

title: Song of Solomon 7:3
text: Your two breasts [are] like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.

title: Song of Solomon 7:4
text: Your neck [is like] a tower of ivory; your eyes [like] the fish-pools in Heshbon, by the gate of Beth-rabbim; your nose [is like] the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.

title: Song of Solomon 7:5
text: Your head on you [is like] Carmel, and the hair of your head like purple cloth; the King [is] held captive in its tresses.

title: Song of Solomon 7:6
text: How beautiful and how pleasant you [are], O love, for delights!

title: Song of Solomon 7:7
text: Your stature is like a palm tree, and your breasts [are] like clusters [of grapes].

title: Song of Solomon 7:8
text: I said, I will go up in the palm tree, I will take hold of its stalk. And please let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, and the smell of your nose like apples;

title: Song of Solomon 7:9
text: and the roof of your mouth like the best wine for my Beloved, that goes [down] smoothly for My Beloved, flowing softly [over] the lips of sleeping ones.

title: Song of Solomon 7:10
text: I [am] my Beloved's, and His desire [is] toward me.

title: Song of Solomon 7:11
text: Come, my Beloved, let us go out into the field; let us stay in the villages.

title: Song of Solomon 7:12
text: Let us rise up early to the vineyards; let us see [if] the vine flowers, whether the tender grape appears, and the pomegranates bud forth; there I will give You my loves.

title: Song of Solomon 7:13
text: The love-apples give a scent, and over our doors [are] all pleasant [fruits], new and old, which I have laid up for You, O my Beloved.

title: Song of Solomon 8:1
text: Who could give You to me [as] my brother, who sucked my mother's breasts? [When] I find You outside, I would kiss You; yea, they would not despise me.

title: Song of Solomon 8:2
text: I would lead You, [and] bring You into my mother's house. You would instruct me; I would cause You to drink spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

title: Song of Solomon 8:3
text: His left hand [would be] under my head, and His right embrace me.

title: Song of Solomon 8:4
text: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, why should you stir up or awaken [my] Love until it pleases?

title: Song of Solomon 8:5
text: Who [is] this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her Beloved? I awakened you under the apple tree; there your mother travailed with you; there she travailed and bore you.

title: Song of Solomon 8:6
text: Set me as a seal on Your heart, as a seal on Your arm; for love [is] strong as death. Jealousy [is] cruel as the grave; its flames [are] flames of fire, a flame of Jehovah.

title: Song of Solomon 8:7
text: Many waters cannot quench love, nor will the rivers overflow it. If [a] man would give all the wealth of his house for love, it would be scorned.

title: Song of Solomon 8:8
text: We have a little sister, and she has no breasts; what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

title: Song of Solomon 8:9
text: If she [is] a wall, we will build on her a palace of silver; and if she [is] a door, we will enclose her [with] boards of cedar.

title: Song of Solomon 8:10
text: I [was] a wall, and my breasts like towers; then I was in His eyes as one finding peace.

title: Song of Solomon 8:11
text: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard to keepers; everyone for its fruit was to bring a thousand of silver.

title: Song of Solomon 8:12
text: My vineyard, which [is] mine, [is] before me; you, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and for the keepers of its fruit, two hundred.

title: Song of Solomon 8:13
text: You who dwell in the gardens, the companions listen to your voice; cause me to hear.

title: Song of Solomon 8:14
text: Hurry, my Beloved, and be like a gazelle, or a young deer, the stag, on the mountains of spices.

title: Isaiah 1:1
text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

title: Isaiah 1:2
text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for the LORD has spoken, I have nursed and brought up sons, and they have rebelled against Me.

title: Isaiah 1:3
text: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master's crib; [but] Israel does not know; My people do not understand.

title: Isaiah 1:4
text: Woe, sinful nation, a people heavy [with] iniquity, a seed of evildoers, sons who make others rotten! They have forsaken the LORD; they have provoked the Holy One of Israel to anger; they have gone away backward.

title: Isaiah 1:5
text: Why should you be stricken any more? You will revolt more and more; the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

title: Isaiah 1:6
text: From the sole of the foot even to the head [there is] no soundness in it; [only] a wound and a stripe and a fresh blow; they have not been closed, nor bound up, nor soothed with oil.

title: Isaiah 1:7
text: Your land [is] wasted, your cities burned with fire. Strangers devour your land right before your eyes, and [it is] wasted, as overthrown by strangers.

title: Isaiah 1:8
text: And the daughter of Zion is left a booth in a vineyard, like a hut in a garden of cucumbers, like a besieged city.

title: Isaiah 1:9
text: Except the LORD of hosts had left us a very small remnant, we would be as Sodom; we would be like Gomorrah.

title: Isaiah 1:10
text: Hear the word of the LORD, rulers of Sodom; give ear to the law of our God, people of Gomorrah.

title: Isaiah 1:11
text: To what purpose [is] the multitude of your sacrifices to Me? says the LORD; I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I do not delight in [the blood of] bulls, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

title: Isaiah 1:12
text: When you come to appear before Me, who has required this at your hand, to trample My courts?

title: Isaiah 1:13
text: Bring no more vain sacrifice; incense is an abomination to Me; the new moon and sabbath, the going to meeting; I cannot endure evil and the assembly!

title: Isaiah 1:14
text: Your new moons and your appointed feasts My soul hates; they are a trouble to Me; I am weary to bear [them].

title: Isaiah 1:15
text: And when you spread out your hands, I will hide My eyes from you; yea, when you make many prayers, I will not hear; your hands are full of blood.

title: Isaiah 1:16
text: Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean; put away the evil of your doings from before My eyes; cease to do evil;

title: Isaiah 1:17
text: learn to do good; seek judgment, reprove the oppressor. Judge the orphan, plead for the widow.

title: Isaiah 1:18
text: Come now, and let us reason together, says the LORD; though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall be like wool.

title: Isaiah 1:19
text: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;

title: Isaiah 1:20
text: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured [with] the sword; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

title: Isaiah 1:21
text: How has the faithful city become a harlot? [It was] full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it, but now murderers.

title: Isaiah 1:22
text: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water;

title: Isaiah 1:23
text: your rulers [are] rebellious, and companions of thieves; everyone loves a bribe, and is pursuing rewards; they do not judge the orphan, nor does the cause of the widow come to them.

title: Isaiah 1:24
text: And the Lord, Jehovah of Hosts, the mighty One of Israel, says, Alas! I will ease Myself of My foes, and avenge Myself of My enemies.

title: Isaiah 1:25
text: And I will turn back My hand on you, and purge away your dross as with lye, and take away all your alloy.

title: Isaiah 1:26
text: And I will restore your judges as at first, and your counselors as at the beginning; afterwards you shall be called the city of righteousness, the faithful city.

title: Isaiah 1:27
text: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her returning ones with righteousness.

title: Isaiah 1:28
text: And the downfall of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together; and those who forsake the LORD [shall be] consumed.

title: Isaiah 1:29
text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be ashamed for the gardens which you have chosen.

title: Isaiah 1:30
text: For you shall be like an oak whose leaf fades, and like a garden that has no water.

title: Isaiah 1:31
text: And the strong shall be like tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall put [them] out.

title: Isaiah 2:1
text: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 2:2
text: And it shall be, in the last days the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow into it.

title: Isaiah 2:3
text: And many people shall go and say, Come, and let us go to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. And He will teach us of His ways, and we will walk in His paths. For out of Zion shall go out the Law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 2:4
text: And He shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

title: Isaiah 2:5
text: O house of Jacob, come and let us walk in the light of the LORD.

title: Isaiah 2:6
text: For You have forsaken Your people the house of Jacob, because they have become full from the east, and [are] fortune-tellers like the Philistines. And they clap their [hands] with the children of strangers.

title: Isaiah 2:7
text: And their land is full of silver and gold. [There is] no end of their treasures and their land is full of horses; nor an end of their chariots.

title: Isaiah 2:8
text: And their land is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

title: Isaiah 2:9
text: And the man bowed down, and man was humbled, but You do not lift them up.

title: Isaiah 2:10
text: Enter into the rock and hide in the dust for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of His majesty.

title: Isaiah 2:11
text: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the pride of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

title: Isaiah 2:12
text: For the day of the LORD of hosts [shall be] on every proud and lofty one, and on every lifted up one; and he [shall be] brought low,

title: Isaiah 2:13
text: And it shall be on all the high and lifted up cedars of Lebanon, and on all the oaks of Bashan,

title: Isaiah 2:14
text: and on all the high mountains, and on all the lifted up hills;

title: Isaiah 2:15
text: and on every high tower, and on every fortified wall;

title: Isaiah 2:16
text: and on all the ships of Tarshish, and on all pleasurable craft.

title: Isaiah 2:17
text: And the pride of man shall be bowed down, and the loftiness of men shall be made low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

title: Isaiah 2:18
text: And the idols shall completely vanish.

title: Isaiah 2:19
text: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth for fear of the LORD and for the glory of His majesty, when He arises to shake the earth terribly.

title: Isaiah 2:20
text: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made for him to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

title: Isaiah 2:21
text: to go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD and for the glory of His majesty, when He arises to shake the earth terribly.

title: Isaiah 2:22
text: Cease from man, whose breath [is] in his nostril; for in what is he to be esteemed?

title: Isaiah 3:1
text: For behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread and the whole stay of water,

title: Isaiah 3:2
text: the mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,

title: Isaiah 3:3
text: the captain of fifty, and the honorable man, and the adviser, and the skilled worker, and the expert charmer.

title: Isaiah 3:4
text: And I will give young boys [to be] their rulers, and caprices shall rule over them.

title: Isaiah 3:5
text: And the people shall be crushed, every man by another, and every man by his neighbor; the boy shall act proudly against the old man, and the low against the honorable.

title: Isaiah 3:6
text: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, [saying], You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand;

title: Isaiah 3:7
text: in that day he shall swear, saying, I will not be a healer; there [is] no bread nor a cloak in my house. You shall not make me a ruler of the people.

title: Isaiah 3:8
text: For Jerusalem is ruined and Judah has fallen; because their tongue and their doings [are] against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of His glory.

title: Isaiah 3:9
text: The look of their faces witnesses against them; and they declare their sin like Sodom. They do not hide [it]! Woe to their soul! For they have rewarded evil to themselves.

title: Isaiah 3:10
text: Say to the righteous that [it is] well; for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

title: Isaiah 3:11
text: Woe to the wicked! For the evil doing of his hand will be done to him.

title: Isaiah 3:12
text: [As for] my people, children [are] their taskmasters, and women rule over them. Oh my people, your rulers cause [you] to go astray and destroy the way of your paths.

title: Isaiah 3:13
text: The LORD stands up to plead His case, and stands up to judge the people.

title: Isaiah 3:14
text: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of His people, and their kings; for you have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor [is] in your houses.

title: Isaiah 3:15
text: What do you mean? You crush My people and grind the faces of the poor? says the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 3:16
text: And the LORD says, Because the daughters of Zion are proud, and have walked with stretched out necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing [as] they go, and making a tinkling with their feet;

title: Isaiah 3:17
text: therefore the LORD will strike with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will make their secret parts naked.

title: Isaiah 3:18
text: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of ankle-bracelets, and the headbands, and the crescents,

title: Isaiah 3:19
text: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the veils;

title: Isaiah 3:20
text: the headdresses, and the leg ornaments, and the sashes, and the houses of the soul, and the amulets;

title: Isaiah 3:21
text: the rings and nose jewels;

title: Isaiah 3:22
text: the festal apparel and the outer garments; and the mantles, and the purses;

title: Isaiah 3:23
text: the mirrors and the fine linen; and the turbans and the veils.

title: Isaiah 3:24
text: And it shall be, instead of sweet smell, there shall be an odor of decay; and instead of a sash, a rope; and instead of well-set hair, baldness; and instead of a rich robe, a wrapping of sackcloth; burning instead of beauty.

title: Isaiah 3:25
text: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

title: Isaiah 3:26
text: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall sit deserted on the ground.

title: Isaiah 4:1
text: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, we will eat our own bread and wear our own clothing; only let us be called by your name, to take away our shame.

title: Isaiah 4:2
text: In that day shall the Branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth excellent and comely for those who have escaped from Israel.

title: Isaiah 4:3
text: And it shall be, he who is left in Zion, and he who remains in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem;

title: Isaiah 4:4
text: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from its midst by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

title: Isaiah 4:5
text: And the LORD will create over all the site of Mount Zion, and on her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for on all the glory [shall be] a defense.

title: Isaiah 4:6
text: And there shall be a booth for a shade by day from the heat, and for a refuge, and for a hiding place from storm and rain.

title: Isaiah 5:1
text: Now I will sing to my Beloved a song of my Beloved concerning His vineyard. My Beloved has a vineyard in a very fruitful hill.

title: Isaiah 5:2
text: And He fenced it, and gathered out the stones of it, and planted it [with] choice vines, and built a tower in its midst, and hewed out a wine vat in it; and He looked [for it] to produce grapes. And it produced wild grapes.

title: Isaiah 5:3
text: And now, O people of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, please judge between Me and My vineyard.

title: Isaiah 5:4
text: What more could have been done to my vineyard that I have not done in it? Who knows? I looked [for it] to yield grapes, but it yielded rotten grapes.

title: Isaiah 5:5
text: And now I will tell you what I will do to My vineyard; I will take away its hedge, and it shall be eaten up; [and] break down its wall, and it shall be trampled down;

title: Isaiah 5:6
text: and I will lay it waste; it shall not be pruned nor dug; but briers and thorns shall come up. And I will command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.

title: Isaiah 5:7
text: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts [is] the house of Israel, and the men of Judah His pleasant plant; and He looked for justice, but behold bloody iniquity; for righteousness, but behold a cry!

title: Isaiah 5:8
text: Woe [to] those who join house to house, laying field to field, until the end of space, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

title: Isaiah 5:9
text: The LORD of hosts [swore] in my ears, Truly many houses shall be deserted, big and fair, without inhabitant.

title: Isaiah 5:10
text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of a homer shall yield an ephah.

title: Isaiah 5:11
text: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning to go after strong drink; tarrying in the twilight [while] wine inflames them!

title: Isaiah 5:12
text: And the lyre, and the harp, the timbrel, and pipe, and wine, are [at] their feasts; but they do not regard the work of the LORD. Yea, they do not see the work of His hands.

title: Isaiah 5:13
text: For this My people go into exile without knowledge, and their honorable men into famine, and his multitude is dried up with thirst.

title: Isaiah 5:14
text: So hell has enlarged itself, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, and their multitude, and their pride, and he who rejoices in her, shall go down into it.

title: Isaiah 5:15
text: And man is bowed down, and man is humbled and the eyes of the lofty are humbled.

title: Isaiah 5:16
text: But the LORD of hosts is exalted in judgment, and God the holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

title: Isaiah 5:17
text: Then shall the lambs feed in their way, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

title: Isaiah 5:18
text: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin with cart ropes;

title: Isaiah 5:19
text: who say, Let Him hurry [and] hasten His work, so that we may see it; and let the purpose of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, so that we may know!

title: Isaiah 5:20
text: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil; who put darkness for light and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!

title: Isaiah 5:21
text: Woe to those wise in their own eyes, and bright in their own sight!

title: Isaiah 5:22
text: Woe to those mighty to drink wine, and brave men to mix strong drink;

title: Isaiah 5:23
text: who justify the wicked for a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

title: Isaiah 5:24
text: So, as the fire devours the stubble, and the flame burns up the chaff; their root shall be like rottenness, and their blossoms shall go up like dust, because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 5:25
text: Therefore the anger of the LORD is kindled on His people, and He has stretched out His hand against them, and has stricken them; and the hills trembled, and their dead bodies [were] as filth in the midst of the streets. In all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand [is] stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 5:26
text: And He will lift up a banner to distant nations, and will hiss to them from the ends of the earth; and behold, they shall come [with] speed swiftly.

title: Isaiah 5:27
text: None [shall be] weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the waistcoat of their loins be loosened, nor the thong of their sandals be broken;

title: Isaiah 5:28
text: whose arrows [are] sharp, and all their bows bent; their horses' hoofs seem like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

title: Isaiah 5:29
text: Their roaring [shall be] like a lion; they shall roar like young lions; for, they shall roar and lay hold of the prey, and carry [it] away safe, and none shall deliver [it].

title: Isaiah 5:30
text: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea; and [one] looks to the land, behold darkness, and lo, darkness! Distress! And the light shall be darkened by its clouds.

title: Isaiah 6:1
text: In the year that king Uzziah died I then saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, and His train filled the temple.

title: Isaiah 6:2
text: Above it stood the seraphs; each one had six wings; with two he covered his face, and with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.

title: Isaiah 6:3
text: And one cried to another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, [is] the LORD of hosts; the whole earth full of His glory.

title: Isaiah 6:4
text: And the doorposts moved at the voice of the one who cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

title: Isaiah 6:5
text: Then I said, Woe [is] me! For I am undone; for I [am] a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 6:6
text: Then one of the seraphs flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, snatched with tongs from the altar.

title: Isaiah 6:7
text: And he laid [it] on my mouth and said, Lo, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin purged.

title: Isaiah 6:8
text: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here [am] I; send me!

title: Isaiah 6:9
text: And He said, Go, and tell this people, You hear indeed, but do not understand; and seeing you see, but do not know.

title: Isaiah 6:10
text: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their hearts, and turn back, and be healed.

title: Isaiah 6:11
text: Then I said, Lord, how long? And He answered, Until the cities are wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land laid waste, a desolation,

title: Isaiah 6:12
text: and [until] the LORD has moved men far away, and the desolation in the midst of the land [is] great.

title: Isaiah 6:13
text: But yet in it [shall be] a tenth, and [it] shall return and be consumed like the terebinth and like the oak being felled, [yet has] its stump; the holy seed [is] its stump.

title: Isaiah 7:1
text: And it happened in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not overcome it.

title: Isaiah 7:2
text: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is allied with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the woods are moved by the wind.

title: Isaiah 7:3
text: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, Go out now to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-jashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the Fuller's Field.

title: Isaiah 7:4
text: And say to him, Be careful and be quiet. Do not fear, nor be timid of heart because of the two tails of these smoking firebrands, because of the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah;

title: Isaiah 7:5
text: because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah have plotted against you, saying,

title: Isaiah 7:6
text: Let us go up against Judah and trouble it, and break her for ourselves, and set a king in the midst of it, the son of Tabeal.

title: Isaiah 7:7
text: So says the Lord God, It shall not stand, nor shall it come to pass.

title: Isaiah 7:8
text: For the head of Syria [is] Damascus, and the head of Damascus [is] Rezin; and within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken so that it shall not be a people.

title: Isaiah 7:9
text: And the head of Ephraim [is] Samaria, and the head of Samaria [is] Remaliah's son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.

title: Isaiah 7:10
text: And the LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

title: Isaiah 7:11
text: Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

title: Isaiah 7:12
text: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, nor will I tempt the LORD.

title: Isaiah 7:13
text: And He said, Hear now, O house of David; [is it] a small thing for you to weary men, but will you weary my God also?

title: Isaiah 7:14
text: So, the Lord Himself shall give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call His name Immanuel.

title: Isaiah 7:15
text: Butter and honey he shall eat until he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

title: Isaiah 7:16
text: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land that you loathe shall be forsaken before both its kings.

title: Isaiah 7:17
text: The LORD shall bring on you, and on your people, and on your father's house, days that have not come, since the days that Ephraim departed from Judah, the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 7:18
text: And it shall be, in that day the LORD shall hiss for the fly at the end of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that [is] in the land of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 7:19
text: And they shall come and all of them shall rest in the desert valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and on all thorns, and on all the pastures.

title: Isaiah 7:20
text: In the same day the Lord shall shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by those Beyond the River, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet; and it shall also sweep away the beard.

title: Isaiah 7:21
text: And it shall be, in that day a man shall keep alive a young cow and two sheep;

title: Isaiah 7:22
text: and it will be, from the plentiful supply of milk they shall give, he shall eat butter; for butter and honey shall everyone eat who is left in the land.

title: Isaiah 7:23
text: And it shall be, in that day every place where there were a thousand vines, [worth] a thousand pieces of silver, [it] shall even be for briers and thorns.

title: Isaiah 7:24
text: With arrows and with the bow [men] shall come there, because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

title: Isaiah 7:25
text: And all hills which were hoed with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of the ox, and for the trampling of sheep.

title: Isaiah 8:1
text: And the LORD said to me, Take a great scroll and write in it with a man's pen: Make Haste [to] Plunder! Hasten to the Prey!

title: Isaiah 8:2
text: And I took to myself faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

title: Isaiah 8:3
text: And I went to the prophetess. And she conceived and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz [Make Haste to Plunder].

title: Isaiah 8:4
text: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and, My mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 8:5
text: The LORD also spoke to me again saying,

title: Isaiah 8:6
text: Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;

title: Isaiah 8:7
text: And therefore, behold, the Lord brings on them the waters of the River, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory. And he shall come up over all his channels and go over all his banks.

title: Isaiah 8:8
text: And he shall pass through Judah. He shall overflow and go over; he shall reach to the neck. And the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of your land, O Immanuel.

title: Isaiah 8:9
text: Suffer evil, O people, and be broken! And give ear, all from the far places of the earth. Gird yourselves and be broken. Gird yourselves and be broken!

title: Isaiah 8:10
text: Counsel a counsel, and it is frustrated. Speak a word, and it shall not stand; for God [is] with us.

title: Isaiah 8:11
text: For so the LORD spoke to me with a strong hand, and warned me against walking in the way of this people, saying,

title: Isaiah 8:12
text: Do not say, A conspiracy! to everything of which this people says, A conspiracy! And do not fear their fear, nor be afraid.

title: Isaiah 8:13
text: Sanctify the LORD of hosts Himself, and [let] Him [be] your fear, and let Him be your dread.

title: Isaiah 8:14
text: And He shall be a sanctuary for you, but for a stone of stumbling, and for a rock of falling to both the houses of Israel, for a trap and for a snare to the people of Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 8:15
text: And many among them shall stumble and fall and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

title: Isaiah 8:16
text: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among My disciples.

title: Isaiah 8:17
text: And I will wait on the LORD, who hides His face from the house of Jacob; and I will look for Him.

title: Isaiah 8:18
text: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me [are] for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, who dwells in Mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 8:19
text: And when they shall say to you, Seek to the mediums and to wizards who peep and mutter; should not a people seek to their God, [than] for the living to the dead?

title: Isaiah 8:20
text: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, [it is] because no light [is] in them.

title: Isaiah 8:21
text: And they shall pass through it, hard-pressed and hungry; and it shall be, they shall be hungry; They shall rave and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

title: Isaiah 8:22
text: And they shall look to the land; and behold, trouble and darkness and gloom of anguish! And they [are] driven away into darkness.

title: Isaiah 9:1
text: Yet there [will be] no gloom for her who [was] in anguish, [as in] the former time. He degraded the land of Zebulun, and the land of Naphtali, so afterwards He will glorify the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

title: Isaiah 9:2
text: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light; they who dwell in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.

title: Isaiah 9:3
text: You have multiplied the nation. You have not increased the joy. They rejoice before You according to the joy in harvest, and [as men] rejoice when they divide the spoil.

title: Isaiah 9:4
text: For You have broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his taskmaster, as [in] the day of Midian.

title: Isaiah 9:5
text: For every boot of the warrior [is] with commotion, and the coat rolled in blood shall be burning fuel for the fire.

title: Isaiah 9:6
text: For to us a Child is born, to us a Son is given; and the government shall be on His shoulder; and His name shall be called Wonderful, Counselor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

title: Isaiah 9:7
text: There is no end of the increase of [His] government and peace on the throne of David, and on His kingdom, to order it and to establish it with judgment and with justice from now on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will do this.

title: Isaiah 9:8
text: The Lord sent a word to Jacob, and it has fallen on Israel.

title: Isaiah 9:9
text: And all the people shall know, Ephraim and the people of Samaria, who say in pride and hardness of heart,

title: Isaiah 9:10
text: The bricks have fallen down, but we will build [with] cut stones; the sycamores are cut down, but we use cedars instead.

title: Isaiah 9:11
text: And the LORD shall set up the foes of Rezin against him, and spur on his enemies;

title: Isaiah 9:12
text: the Syrians in front and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand [is] stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 9:13
text: For the people do not turn to Him who strikes them, nor do they seek the LORD of hosts.

title: Isaiah 9:14
text: And the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, [in] one day.

title: Isaiah 9:15
text: The elder and honorable, he is the head; and the prophet who teaches lies, he [is] the tail.

title: Isaiah 9:16
text: For the leaders of this people led [them] astray; and their guided ones [are] swallowed up.

title: Isaiah 9:17
text: For this the Lord shall not rejoice over their young men, nor shall He have mercy on their orphans and widows; for everyone [is] a hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks foolishness. In all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand [is] stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 9:18
text: For wickedness burns like the fire; it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall roll upwards [like] the lifting up of smoke.

title: Isaiah 9:19
text: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land scorched, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire; no man shall have pity on his brother.

title: Isaiah 9:20
text: And [he shall] cut off on the right hand and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left, and they shall not be satisfied. Each man shall eat the flesh of his own arm;

title: Isaiah 9:21
text: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; [and] they together [shall be] against Judah. In all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 10:1
text: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the scribes [who] write toil;

title: Isaiah 10:2
text: to turn aside the needy from judgment, and to steal the right from the poor of My people, that widows may be their prey, and they rob the orphans!

title: Isaiah 10:3
text: And what will you do in the day of judgment and in destruction? It comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your glory?

title: Isaiah 10:4
text: Surely they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. In all this His hand is not turned away, but His hand [is] stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 10:5
text: Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger! And the staff in their hand is My fury.

title: Isaiah 10:6
text: I will send him against an ungodly nation, and against the people of My wrath. I will command him to take the plunder, and to strip off the spoil, and to trample them like the mud of the streets.

title: Isaiah 10:7
text: Yet he does not plan this, nor does his heart think so. For [it is] in his heart to destroy and cut off not a few nations.

title: Isaiah 10:8
text: For he says, [Are] not my commanders all like kings?

title: Isaiah 10:9
text: [Is] not Calno like Carchemish? [Is] not Hamath like Arpad? [Is] not Samaria like Damascus?

title: Isaiah 10:10
text: As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols, and their graven images [more than] Jerusalem's and Samaria's;

title: Isaiah 10:11
text: shall I not do to Jerusalem and her idols as I have done to Samaria and her idols?

title: Isaiah 10:12
text: And it will be, when the Lord has broken off all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the proud heart of the king of Assyria and the glory of his high looks.

title: Isaiah 10:13
text: For he says, By the strength of my hand I have done [it], and by my wisdom; for I am wise. And I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the people like a strong man.

title: Isaiah 10:14
text: And my hand has found as a nest the riches of the people; and as one gathers eggs [that are] left, I have gathered all the earth; and there was none who moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

title: Isaiah 10:15
text: Shall the axe boast itself against him who chops with it? Shall the saw magnify itself against him who moves it? As [if] the rod [could] wave those who lift [itself] up! As [if] a staff could raise [what is] not wood!

title: Isaiah 10:16
text: Therefore the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, shall send leanness among his fat ones; and under his glory [He] shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

title: Isaiah 10:17
text: And the light of Israel shall be as a fire, and His holy One as a flame; and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

title: Isaiah 10:18
text: And it shall burn up the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body; and they shall be as when a sick one faints.

title: Isaiah 10:19
text: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a boy might write them.

title: Isaiah 10:20
text: And it shall be in that day, the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob, shall never again lean on him who struck them; but truly lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 10:21
text: The remnant shall return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

title: Isaiah 10:22
text: For though Your people Israel are like the sand of the sea, [yet] a remnant of them shall return; the full end which is decreed shall overflow [with] righteousness.

title: Isaiah 10:23
text: For the Lord Jehovah of hosts shall make a full end, as ordained, in the midst of all the land.

title: Isaiah 10:24
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah of hosts, O my people who dwell [in] Zion, do not fear Assyria. He shall strike you with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against you, in the way of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 10:25
text: But yet a little while, and the fury shall cease, and My anger [shall be] in their ruin.

title: Isaiah 10:26
text: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a whip on him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and [as] His rod was on the sea, so shall He lift it up in the way of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 10:27
text: And it shall be, in that day his burden shall be taken away from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

title: Isaiah 10:28
text: He has come to Aiath, he has passed to Migron; at Michmash he has stored his baggage;

title: Isaiah 10:29
text: they have gone over the passage; they have bedded down at Geba; Ramah is afraid, Gibeah of Saul has fled.

title: Isaiah 10:30
text: Lift up your voice, daughter of heaps; shriek with your voice; bow Laish, afflicted of Anathoth.

title: Isaiah 10:31
text: Madmenah wanders; the people of Gebim take refuge.

title: Isaiah 10:32
text: Yet [he] shall remain in Nob today; [he] shall shake his hand [against] the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 10:33
text: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror; and the lofty ones [shall be] cut down, and the proud shall be humbled.

title: Isaiah 10:34
text: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

title: Isaiah 11:1
text: And a Shoot goes out from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots.

title: Isaiah 11:2
text: And the Spirit of the LORD shall rest on Him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.

title: Isaiah 11:3
text: And He is made to breathe in the fear of the LORD. And He shall not judge according to the sight of His eyes, nor decide by the hearing of His ears.

title: Isaiah 11:4
text: But with righteousness He shall judge the poor, and shall decide with uprightness for the meek of the earth. And He shall strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, and with the breath of His lips He shall slay the wicked.

title: Isaiah 11:5
text: And righteousness shall be the girdle of His loins, and faithfulness the girdle of His heart.

title: Isaiah 11:6
text: Also the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the cub lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

title: Isaiah 11:7
text: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

title: Isaiah 11:8
text: And the suckling child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder's den.

title: Isaiah 11:9
text: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

title: Isaiah 11:10
text: And in that day there shall be the Root of Jesse standing for a banner of the people; to Him the nations shall seek; and His resting place shall be glorious.

title: Isaiah 11:11
text: And it shall be in that day, the Lord shall again set His hand, the second time, to recover the remnant of His people that remains, from Assyria and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Ethiopia, and from Persia, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the coasts of the sea.

title: Isaiah 11:12
text: And He shall lift up a banner for the nations, and shall gather the outcasts of Israel and gather together the scattered ones of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

title: Isaiah 11:13
text: And the envy of Ephraim shall depart, and the foes of Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not trouble Ephraim.

title: Isaiah 11:14
text: But they shall fly on the shoulders of the Philistines to the west; they shall spoil the sons of the east together; they shall lay their hand on Edom and Moab; and the sons of Ammon shall obey them.

title: Isaiah 11:15
text: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with His scorching wind He shall shake His hand over the River, and shall strike it into seven streams, and make one tread [it] with shoes.

title: Isaiah 11:16
text: And there shall be a highway for the remnant of His people, those left from Assyria; as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 12:1
text: And in that day you shall say, O LORD, I will praise You; though You were angry with me, turn away Your anger, and You shall comfort me.

title: Isaiah 12:2
text: Behold, God [is] my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; He also has become my salvation.

title: Isaiah 12:3
text: And with joy you shall draw water out of the wells of salvation.

title: Isaiah 12:4
text: And in that day you shall say, Praise the LORD! Call on His name; declare His doings among the people, make mention that His name is exalted.

title: Isaiah 12:5
text: Sing [to] the LORD; for He has done excellent things; this [is] known in all the earth.

title: Isaiah 12:6
text: Cry out and shout, O dweller of Zion; for great [is] the Holy One of Israel in your midst.

title: Isaiah 13:1
text: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw:

title: Isaiah 13:2
text: Lift up a banner on a bare mountain, exalt the voice to them, shake the hand, so that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

title: Isaiah 13:3
text: I have commanded My holy ones, I have also called My mighty ones for anger, those who rejoice in My highness.

title: Isaiah 13:4
text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together; the LORD of hosts gathers an army for the battle.

title: Isaiah 13:5
text: They come from a far country, from the end of the heavens, the LORD and the weapons of His indignation, to destroy all land.

title: Isaiah 13:6
text: Howl! For the day of the LORD [is] at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

title: Isaiah 13:7
text: Therefore all hands shall be faint, and every man's heart shall melt;

title: Isaiah 13:8
text: and they shall be afraid. Pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them. They shall be in pain like a woman who travails. They shall be amazed at one another, their faces [like] flames.

title: Isaiah 13:9
text: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel and [with] wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land waste; and He shall destroy its sinners out of it.

title: Isaiah 13:10
text: For the stars of the heavens and their constellations shall not give light; the sun shall be darkened in its going forth, and the moon shall not reflect its light.

title: Isaiah 13:11
text: And I will visit evil on the world, and their iniquity on the wicked. And I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will lay low the pride of tyrants.

title: Isaiah 13:12
text: I will make a man more precious than gold; even a man than the fine gold of Ophir.

title: Isaiah 13:13
text: So I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall move out of its place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of His fierce anger.

title: Isaiah 13:14
text: And it shall be as a driven gazelle, and as a sheep that no man takes up; each man shall look to his own people, and each one flee into his own land.

title: Isaiah 13:15
text: Everyone who is found shall be thrust through; and everyone who is joined [to them] shall fall by the sword.

title: Isaiah 13:16
text: And their children shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be robbed, and their wives raped.

title: Isaiah 13:17
text: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who shall not value silver; and they shall not delight in gold.

title: Isaiah 13:18
text: And bows shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not pity sons.

title: Isaiah 13:19
text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the majestic beauty of the Chaldees, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

title: Isaiah 13:20
text: It shall never be inhabited forever, nor shall it be lived in from generation to generation; nor shall the Arabian pitch his tent there; nor shall the shepherds make their [flocks] lie down there.

title: Isaiah 13:21
text: But the wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of howling creatures; and ostriches shall dwell there, and he-goats shall dance there.

title: Isaiah 13:22
text: And hyenas shall cry along with his widows, and jackals in palaces of delight. Yea, her time is coming near, and her days shall not be prolonged.

title: Isaiah 14:1
text: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel and set them in their own land; and the stranger shall be joined with them, and they shall cling to the house of Jacob.

title: Isaiah 14:2
text: And the peoples shall take them and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for slaves and slave girls. And they shall be captives of their captors; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

title: Isaiah 14:3
text: And it shall be in the day that the LORD shall give you rest from your sorrow, and from your fear, and from the hard bondage which was pressed on you,

title: Isaiah 14:4
text: you shall take up this song against the king of Babylon and say, How the exacter, the gold gatherer has ceased!

title: Isaiah 14:5
text: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers

title: Isaiah 14:6
text: who struck peoples in wrath, a blow without turning away, ruling the nations in anger, a persecution without restraint.

title: Isaiah 14:7
text: All the earth is at rest [and] is quiet; they break out into singing.

title: Isaiah 14:8
text: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at you, the cedars of Lebanon, [saying], Since you have fallen, no woodcutter will come up against us.

title: Isaiah 14:9
text: Hell from below is moved for you, to meet [you] at your coming. It stirs up the dead for you, all the he-goats of the earth. It has raised from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

title: Isaiah 14:10
text: All of them shall speak and say to you, Are you also as weak as we? Are you like us?

title: Isaiah 14:11
text: Your pride is brought down to the grave, [and] the noise of your harps. The maggot is spread under you, and the worms cover you.

title: Isaiah 14:12
text: How you are fallen from the heavens, O shining star, son of the morning! [How] you are cut down to the ground, you who weakened the nations!

title: Isaiah 14:13
text: For you have said in your heart, I will go up [to] the heavens, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God; I will also sit on the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north.

title: Isaiah 14:14
text: I will go up above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the Most High.

title: Isaiah 14:15
text: Yet you shall be brought down to hell, to the sides of the Pit.

title: Isaiah 14:16
text: Those who see you shall stare and closely watch you, [saying], Is this the man who made the earth to tremble; who shook kingdoms;

title: Isaiah 14:17
text: [who] made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed its cities; [who] did not open the house for his prisoners?

title: Isaiah 14:18
text: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

title: Isaiah 14:19
text: But you are cast out of your grave [like] a hateful branch, [and like] the clothing of those who are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trampled under foot.

title: Isaiah 14:20
text: You shall not be joined with them in burial, because you ruined your land [and] killed your people; the seed of evildoers shall never be famous.

title: Isaiah 14:21
text: Prepare slaughter for his sons, because of the iniquity of their fathers, so that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world [with] cities.

title: Isaiah 14:22
text: For I will rise up against them, says the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name and remnant, and son, and grandson, says the LORD.

title: Isaiah 14:23
text: I will also make it a possession of the hedgehog, and pools of water; and I will sweep it with the broom of ruin, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Isaiah 14:24
text: The LORD of hosts has sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so it shall come to pass; and as I have purposed, it shall stand;

title: Isaiah 14:25
text: to break Assyria in My land and on My mountains trample him under foot. Then his yoke shall be removed from them, and his burden shall be taken off their shoulders.

title: Isaiah 14:26
text: This [is] the purpose that [is] purposed on all the earth; and this [is] the hand that [is] stretched out on all the nations.

title: Isaiah 14:27
text: For the LORD of hosts has purposed, and who shall reverse [it]? And this His hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

title: Isaiah 14:28
text: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died:

title: Isaiah 14:29
text: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of you, that the rod of your striking is broken. For a viper comes forth from the root of a snake, and his fruit [shall be] a fiery flying serpent.

title: Isaiah 14:30
text: And the first-born of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and he shall slay your remnant.

title: Isaiah 14:31
text: Howl, O gate! Cry, O city! O Philistia, all of you, [are] melted away; for from the north a smoke comes, and no straggler in his ranks.

title: Isaiah 14:32
text: What shall [one] then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and the poor of His people shall trust in it.

title: Isaiah 15:1
text: The burden of Moab. Because in a night Ar of Moab is laid waste; it is cut off; because in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste; it is cut off.

title: Isaiah 15:2
text: One has gone up to the house, even to Dibon, the high places, to weep. Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba; baldness [shall be] on all their heads, every beard cut off.

title: Isaiah 15:3
text: In the streets they shall clothe themselves with sackcloth; on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, everyone shall howl, melting in tears.

title: Isaiah 15:4
text: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh; their voice shall be heard as far as Jahaz. So the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life is broken to him.

title: Isaiah 15:5
text: My heart shall cry to Moab; his fugitives [flee] to Zoar, a heifer of three years. He goes up the ascent to Luhith with weeping; for [in] the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of ruin.

title: Isaiah 15:6
text: For the waters of Nimrim are desolation; for the hay has dried up and the grass fails, there is no green thing.

title: Isaiah 15:7
text: Therefore one made up the remainder and their store; over the torrent of the willows they shall carry them.

title: Isaiah 15:8
text: For the cry has gone around the border of Moab, its howling even to Eglaim; yea, its howling even to Beer-elim.

title: Isaiah 15:9
text: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will put on Dimon more things for the escaped ones of Moab, a lion, even for the remnant of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:1
text: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land from the rock of the desert to the mount of the daughter of Zion.

title: Isaiah 16:2
text: For it shall be as a fleeing bird cast out of the nest, the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

title: Isaiah 16:3
text: Take counsel, do judgment; make your shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; do not betray the fugitive.

title: Isaiah 16:4
text: Let my outcasts dwell with you, Moab; be a shelter to them from the face of the destroyer; for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceases, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:5
text: And in mercy the throne shall be established; and [he] shall sit on it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging and seeking judgment, and speeding righteousness.

title: Isaiah 16:6
text: We have heard of the pride of Moab; very proud; even of his vanity, and his pride, and his rage; not so [are] his babblings.

title: Isaiah 16:7
text: So Moab shall howl for Moab, everyone shall howl. All of it shall howl for the foundations of Kir-hareseth; surely [they are] stricken.

title: Isaiah 16:8
text: For Heshbon's fields droop, the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have crushed its choice plants, they have come to Jazer, they wander [in] the desert; her branches are stretched out, they have crossed the sea.

title: Isaiah 16:9
text: On account of this I will weep with the weeping of Jazer, the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh; for the shouting has fallen on your fruit and on your harvest.

title: Isaiah 16:10
text: And gladness and joy are gathered out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there is no singing and no shouting. The treader shall tread out no wine in the presses; I have made their shouting to cease.

title: Isaiah 16:11
text: Therefore my belly shall sound like a harp for Moab, and my bowels for Kir-hareseth.

title: Isaiah 16:12
text: And it shall be when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, he shall come to his sacred place to pray; but he shall not be able.

title: Isaiah 16:13
text: This [is] the word that the LORD has spoken to Moab since that time.

title: Isaiah 16:14
text: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of a hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be abased with all that great host and the remnant few; small, not mighty.

title: Isaiah 17:1
text: The burden against Damascus: Behold, Damascus is taken away from [being] a city, and it shall be a heap of ruins.

title: Isaiah 17:2
text: The cities of Aroer [are] forsaken; now they are for flocks; they shall lie down, and no one terrifies them.

title: Isaiah 17:3
text: And the fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the rest of Syria. They shall be as the glory of the sons of Israel, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Isaiah 17:4
text: And it shall be in that day, the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall become lean.

title: Isaiah 17:5
text: And it shall be as reaping of the harvest grain, and his arm reaps the ears. And it shall be as he who gathers ears in the Valley of the Giants.

title: Isaiah 17:6
text: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two [or] three ripe olives in the top of the uppermost branch, four [or] five in the fruit-tree branches of it, says the LORD God of hosts.

title: Isaiah 17:7
text: In that day a man shall look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:8
text: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, nor respect that which his fingers have made, either the Asherahs or the images.

title: Isaiah 17:9
text: In that day his strong cities shall be like a forsaken branch, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the sons of Israel; and it will become a ruin.

title: Isaiah 17:10
text: Because you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not been mindful of the Rock of your strength, therefore you shall plant pleasant plants and shall sow it a fresh shoot.

title: Isaiah 17:11
text: In the day of your planting you fence it in; and in the morning you make your seed sprout. [But] the harvest [shall be] a heap in that day of grief and dying pain.

title: Isaiah 17:12
text: Woe [to] the multitude of many people, [who] make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations who make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

title: Isaiah 17:13
text: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters; but [God] shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

title: Isaiah 17:14
text: At evening time, behold, terror! Before the morning, he [is] not! This [is] the lot of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

title: Isaiah 18:1
text: Woe to the land of whirring of wings, which [is] beyond the rivers of Ethiopia,

title: Isaiah 18:2
text: which sends ambassadors by the sea, even in ships of papyrus on the waters, [saying], Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a terrifying people from it and onwards; a mighty nation and trampling down, whose land the rivers have divided!

title: Isaiah 18:3
text: All people of the world and dwellers on the earth, you will see as one lifts up a banner on the peaks. And you will hear as the blowing of a trumpet.

title: Isaiah 18:4
text: For so the LORD said to me, I will take My rest, and I will look on in My dwelling place, like a clear heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

title: Isaiah 18:5
text: For before the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, then He will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away [and] cut down the branches.

title: Isaiah 18:6
text: They shall be left together to the birds of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth; and the birds shall summer on them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter on them.

title: Isaiah 18:7
text: In that time shall be brought to the LORD of hosts the present from a terrifying, a tall and smooth people, from it and onward; a mighty and trampling nation whose land the rivers have divided, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, Mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 19:1
text: The burden against Egypt: Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud and comes into Egypt. And the idols of Egypt shall tremble at His presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in its midst.

title: Isaiah 19:2
text: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians; and they shall fight each man against his brother, and each against his neighbor; city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

title: Isaiah 19:3
text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst of it, and I will destroy its wisdom. And they shall seek to idols, and to the enchanters, and to the mediums, and to the future-tellers.

title: Isaiah 19:4
text: And I will shut up Egypt into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, says the Lord, The LORD of hosts.

title: Isaiah 19:5
text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall fail and dry up.

title: Isaiah 19:6
text: And rivers shall be fouled; the Nile of Egypt will languish and dry up; the reed and the rush shall decay.

title: Isaiah 19:7
text: Bare places shall be at the Nile, by the mouth of the Nile, and everything sown by the Nile shall dry up, driven away, and be no [more].

title: Isaiah 19:8
text: The fishermen also shall mourn, and all who drop a hook into the Nile shall wail, and those who spread nets on the waters shall droop.

title: Isaiah 19:9
text: And the workers in fine flax, and the weavers of white cloth shall be ashamed.

title: Isaiah 19:10
text: And her foundations shall be broken, and all who make wages shall be sad of soul.

title: Isaiah 19:11
text: Surely the rulers of Zoan [are] fools, the counsel of the wise counselors of Pharaoh has become brutish. How do you say to Pharaoh, I [am] the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

title: Isaiah 19:12
text: Where [are] they? Where [are] your wise men? And let them tell you now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts has planned against Egypt.

title: Isaiah 19:13
text: The rulers of Zoan have become fools, the rulers of Noph are deceived; they have also caused Egypt to go astray, the chief of her tribes.

title: Isaiah 19:14
text: The LORD has mixed a perverse spirit in its midst; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all its work, like a drunkard staggers in his vomit.

title: Isaiah 19:15
text: And Egypt shall have no work that the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

title: Isaiah 19:16
text: In that day Egypt shall be like women; and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which He shakes over it.

title: Isaiah 19:17
text: And the land of Judah shall be a terror to Egypt; everyone who mentions it shall be afraid toward it, because of the purpose of the LORD of hosts, which He has purposed against it.

title: Isaiah 19:18
text: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt shall speak the language of Canaan and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called the City of Ruin.

title: Isaiah 19:19
text: In that day there shall be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at its border to the LORD.

title: Isaiah 19:20
text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt. For they shall cry to the LORD because of the oppressors, and He shall send them a deliverer, and a great one, and will deliver them.

title: Isaiah 19:21
text: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and Egypt shall know the LORD in that day, and shall offer sacrifice and offering; and vow a vow to the LORD, and repay.

title: Isaiah 19:22
text: And the LORD shall strike Egypt; He shall strike and heal; and they shall return to the LORD, and He shall hear them and shall heal them.

title: Isaiah 19:23
text: In that day there shall be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria shall come into Egypt, and Egypt into Assyria, and Egypt shall serve with Assyria.

title: Isaiah 19:24
text: In that day Israel shall be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the land;

title: Isaiah 19:25
text: whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed [be] My people Egypt, and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance.

title: Isaiah 20:1
text: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and fought against Ashdod and took it;

title: Isaiah 20:2
text: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and take the sackcloth off your loins, and take your shoe off your foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

title: Isaiah 20:3
text: And the LORD said, Just as My servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years, a sign and wonder on Egypt and on Ethiopia;

title: Isaiah 20:4
text: so shall the king of Assyria lead away Egypt's prisoners, and the Ethiopian exiles, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with uncovered buttocks, [to] the shame of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 20:5
text: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their hope, and of Egypt their glory.

title: Isaiah 20:6
text: And he who lives in this coast shall say in that day, Behold, this [has become] of our hope [to] which we fled for help there, to be delivered from before the king of Assyria; and, How shall we escape?

title: Isaiah 21:1
text: The burden against the desert of the sea: As tempests in the south pass, it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.

title: Isaiah 21:2
text: A harsh vision is revealed to me; the deceiver deceives, and the plunderer plunders. Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media! I have caused all her sighing to cease.

title: Isaiah 21:3
text: Therefore my loins are filled [with] pain; pangs have taken hold on me like the pangs of a woman who travails; I was bowed down from hearing; I was troubled from seeing.

title: Isaiah 21:4
text: My heart wanders, terror overwhelms me; He has turned the twilight of my pleasure into trembling.

title: Isaiah 21:5
text: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink; arise, rulers. Anoint the shield.

title: Isaiah 21:6
text: For so the LORD has said to me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he sees.

title: Isaiah 21:7
text: And he saw a chariot [with] a pair of horsemen, a chariot of an ass, and a chariot of a camel. And let him listen, very attentively.

title: Isaiah 21:8
text: And he cried, A lion! My lord, without ceasing, I stand on the watchtower by day, and I am stationed at my post all the nights.

title: Isaiah 21:9
text: And, behold, here comes a chariot of a man, a pair of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon has fallen, has fallen! And all the graven images of her gods He has smashed to the ground.

title: Isaiah 21:10
text: O my threshing, and the grain of my floor! That which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

title: Isaiah 21:11
text: The burden against Dumah: [He] calls to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

title: Isaiah 21:12
text: The watchman said, The morning comes, and also the night; if you will inquire, inquire, and come again.

title: Isaiah 21:13
text: The burden against Arabia: You shall stay in the forest of Arabia, O traveling companies of Dedanites.

title: Isaiah 21:14
text: The people of the land of Tema brought water to him who was thirsty; [they went] before him who fled with their bread.

title: Isaiah 21:15
text: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the press of war.

title: Isaiah 21:16
text: For so has the LORD said to me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;

title: Isaiah 21:17
text: and the rest of the number of archers, the mighty men of the sons of Kedar, shall be cut down; for the LORD God of Israel has spoken.

title: Isaiah 22:1
text: The burden against the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have gone up to the housetops?

title: Isaiah 22:2
text: Crashings fill the noisy city, the joyous city Your slain ones [are] not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

title: Isaiah 22:3
text: All your rulers fled together; they were bound without the bow; all found in you are bound together; they have fled from afar.

title: Isaiah 22:4
text: Therefore I said, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly; do not hurry to comfort me because of the ruin of the daughter of my people.

title: Isaiah 22:5
text: For [it is] a day of trouble, and of trampling down, and of doubt by the LORD God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountain.

title: Isaiah 22:6
text: And Persia carried the quiver with chariots of men [and] horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

title: Isaiah 22:7
text: And it happened, your choicest valleys were full of chariots; and the horsemen surely set in order at the gate.

title: Isaiah 22:8
text: And he removed Judah's covering, and you looked in that day to the armor of the house of the forest.

title: Isaiah 22:9
text: You have seen also the breaks in the city of David, that they are many; and you gathered the waters of the lower pool.

title: Isaiah 22:10
text: And you have counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you have broken down the houses to fortify the wall.

title: Isaiah 22:11
text: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool; but you have not looked to its Maker, nor see Him who formed it long ago.

title: Isaiah 22:12
text: And in that day the LORD of hosts called to weeping and mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth.

title: Isaiah 22:13
text: Then, lo, joy and gladness, slaying oxen and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine, saying, Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!

title: Isaiah 22:14
text: And it was revealed in my ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you until you die, says the Lord Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 22:15
text: So says the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Go, go up to this treasurer, to Shebna who [is] over the house. Say,

title: Isaiah 22:16
text: What is to you here? And who is here to you, that you have carved out a tomb for yourself here, [as] one who cuts himself out a tomb on high, who cuts out a home for himself in a rock?

title: Isaiah 22:17
text: Behold, the LORD will hurl you with a hurling, O man, and grasps you with a grasping.

title: Isaiah 22:18
text: Whirling, He will whirl you [like] a ball into a large country; there you shall die, and there are the chariots of your glory, the shame of your lord's house.

title: Isaiah 22:19
text: And I will drive you from your position, and he will pull you from your station.

title: Isaiah 22:20
text: And in that day it shall be, even I will call My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah.

title: Isaiah 22:21
text: and I will clothe him with your robe, and will fasten your girdle on him, and I will give your authority into his hand. And he shall be a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.

title: Isaiah 22:22
text: And the key of the house of David I will lay on his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

title: Isaiah 22:23
text: And I will fasten him [as] a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.

title: Isaiah 22:24
text: And they shall hang on him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the offshoots, all small vessels, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of jars.

title: Isaiah 22:25
text: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, the nail that is fastened in the sure place shall be removed, and be cut down, and fall. And the burden that [was] on it shall be cut off. The LORD has spoken.

title: Isaiah 23:1
text: The burden against Tyre: Howl, ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

title: Isaiah 23:2
text: Be still, inhabitants of the coast, merchant of Sidon, who pass over the sea. They have filled you.

title: Isaiah 23:3
text: And by great waters, the seed of Sihor and the harvest of the river Nile [was] her revenue; and she a mart of nations.

title: Isaiah 23:4
text: Be ashamed, O Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the strength of the sea, saying, I have not travailed nor brought forth. I have not nourished young men [nor] raised up virgins.

title: Isaiah 23:5
text: As the report comes to Egypt, [so] they shall be grieved at the report of Tyre.

title: Isaiah 23:6
text: Pass over Tarshish. Howl, inhabitants of the coast!

title: Isaiah 23:7
text: [Is] this your joyous [city] from days of her old age? Her own feet carry it afar off to stay.

title: Isaiah 23:8
text: Who has purposed this against Tyre, the crowning [city], whose merchants are rulers, whose merchants are the weighty of the earth?

title: Isaiah 23:9
text: The LORD of hosts has purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory [and] to bring into contempt all the weighty of the earth.

title: Isaiah 23:10
