text: [They] say, If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him and will be for another man, will he return to her again? Would not that land be greatly defiled? But you play the harlot with many lovers; yet come back to Me, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 3:2
text: Lift up your eyes to the high places, and see. Where have you not been lain with? By the highways you have sat for them, like the Arabian in the wilderness; and you have defiled the land with your fornications and with your wickedness.

title: Jeremiah 3:3
text: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and there has been no latter rain; and you had a harlot's forehead, you refused to be ashamed.

title: Jeremiah 3:4
text: Will you not from this time cry to Me, My father, [You are] the guide of my youth?

title: Jeremiah 3:5
text: Will He keep [His anger] forever? Will He keep it to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done [all] the evil things you could do.

title: Jeremiah 3:6
text: The LORD also said to me in the days of Josiah the king, Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has fornicated there.

title: Jeremiah 3:7
text: And I said after she had done all these [things], Turn to Me! But she did not return. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

title: Jeremiah 3:8
text: And I saw, when for all the causes [for] which backsliding Israel committed adultery, I sent her away and gave a bill of divorce to her, yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear, but she went and whored, she also.

title: Jeremiah 3:9
text: And it happened, from the folly of her whoredom, she defiled the land and fornicated with stones and stocks.

title: Jeremiah 3:10
text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah has not turned to Me with her whole heart, but with falsehood, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 3:11
text: And the LORD said to me, The backsliding Israel has justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

title: Jeremiah 3:12
text: Go and cry these words toward the north, and say, Return, O backsliding Israel, says the LORD; [and] I will not cause My anger to fall on you; for I [am] merciful, says the LORD, [and] I will not keep anger forever.

title: Jeremiah 3:13
text: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have sinned against the LORD your God and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed My voice, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 3:14
text: Turn, O backsliding sons, says the LORD; for I am married to you; and I will take you one from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

title: Jeremiah 3:15
text: And I will give you shepherds according to My heart, who shall feed you [with] knowledge and understanding.

title: Jeremiah 3:16
text: And it will be when you have multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, says the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD! Nor shall it come to mind; nor shall they remember it; nor shall they visit [it] ; nor shall it be made any more.

title: Jeremiah 3:17
text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem. Nor shall they walk any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

title: Jeremiah 3:18
text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance to your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 3:19
text: But I said, How shall I put you among the sons, and give you a pleasant land, a beautiful inheritance [among] the hosts of nations? And I said, You shall call Me, My Father, and shall not turn away from Me.

title: Jeremiah 3:20
text: Surely [as] a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 3:21
text: A voice was heard on the high places weeping, cryings of the sons of Israel; for they have perverted their way, [and] they have forgotten the LORD their God.

title: Jeremiah 3:22
text: Return, O backsliding sons, [and] I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come to You; for You are the LORD our God.

title: Jeremiah 3:23
text: Truly, for delusion [comes] from the high hills, tumult [on] the mountains. Truly, in the LORD our God [is] the salvation of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 3:24
text: For shame has eaten up the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

title: Jeremiah 3:25
text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covers us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.

title: Jeremiah 4:1
text: If you will return, O Israel, says the LORD, return to Me. And if you will put away your abominations out of your sight, then you shall not be moved.

title: Jeremiah 4:2
text: And you shall swear, The LORD lives, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in Him, and in Him they shall glory.

title: Jeremiah 4:3
text: For so says the LORD to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and do not sow among thorns.

title: Jeremiah 4:4
text: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, men of Judah and people of Jerusalem; lest My fury come forth like fire, and burn so that none can put [it] out; because of the evil of your doings.

title: Jeremiah 4:5
text: Declare in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; and say, Blow the trumpet in the land; cry, gather together, and say, Gather yourselves and let us go into the fortified cities.

title: Jeremiah 4:6
text: Set up the banner toward Zion; flee for safety and do not wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great ruin.

title: Jeremiah 4:7
text: The lion has come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the nations has set out; he has left his place to make your land a waste. Your cities will fall into ruins without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 4:8
text: Put on sackcloth for this, wail and howl; for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

title: Jeremiah 4:9
text: And it shall be at that day, says the LORD, the king's heart will perish, and the heart of the rulers; and the priests will be amazed, and the prophets will be astounded.

title: Jeremiah 4:10
text: Then I said, Ah, Lord GOD! Surely You have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, You shall have peace; but the sword reaches to the soul.

title: Jeremiah 4:11
text: At that time it shall be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind [from] the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of My people, not to sift nor to cleanse.

title: Jeremiah 4:12
text: A wind more full than these shall come for Me. Now also I will utter judgments against them.

title: Jeremiah 4:13
text: Behold, he shall come up like clouds, and his chariots like a tempest. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are plundered!

title: Jeremiah 4:14
text: O Jerusalem, cleanse your heart from evil so that you may be saved. How long shall your vain thoughts lodge within you?

title: Jeremiah 4:15
text: For a voice declares from Dan, and proclaims affliction from mount Ephraim.

title: Jeremiah 4:16
text: Tell [it] to the nations: Behold! proclaim against Jerusalem! Besiegers are going to come from a distant land; and they will set their voice against the cities of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 4:17
text: Like watchmen of a field, they are against her all around; because she rebelled against Me, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 4:18
text: Your way and your doings have brought these [things] on you; this is your evil, because it is bitter, because it reaches to your heart.

title: Jeremiah 4:19
text: My bowels, my bowels! I convulse in pain. O walls of my heart! My heart is restless within me; I cannot be silent because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the ram's horn, the alarm of war.

title: Jeremiah 4:20
text: Ruin on ruin is cried; for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are laid waste, my curtains in a moment.

title: Jeremiah 4:21
text: How long shall I see the banner [and] hear the sound of the ram's horn?

title: Jeremiah 4:22
text: For My people [are] foolish; they have not known Me; they are stupid sons, and they have no understanding. They are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

title: Jeremiah 4:23
text: I looked on the earth, and, lo, [it was] without form and void; and the heavens, and they [had] no light.

title: Jeremiah 4:24
text: I looked on the mountains, and, lo, they quaked; and all the hills were shaken.

title: Jeremiah 4:25
text: I looked, and, lo, [there was] no man, and all the birds of the heavens had fled.

title: Jeremiah 4:26
text: I looked, and, lo, the fruitful place [was] a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down before the face of the LORD, before His fierce anger.

title: Jeremiah 4:27
text: For so the LORD has said, The whole land shall be desolate, yet I will not make a full end.

title: Jeremiah 4:28
text: The earth shall mourn for this, and the heavens above shall be black, because I have spoken, I have purposed, and will not repent, nor will I turn back from it.

title: Jeremiah 4:29
text: Every city shall flee from the sound of the horsemen and bowmen. They shall go into thickets and climb up among the rocks. All the city is abandoned, and not a man shall live in them.

title: Jeremiah 4:30
text: And you, O desolate one, what will you do? Though you dress with crimson, though you put on ornaments of gold, though you make your eyes large with paint, you shall make yourself beautiful in vain; your lovers will despise you; they will seek your life.

title: Jeremiah 4:31
text: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in labor, the anguish as one bearing her first child, the voice of Zion's daughter, gasping and spreading her hands, [saying], Woe to me now! For my soul faints because of murderers.

title: Jeremiah 5:1
text: Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in her open places, if you can find a man, if there is one who does justice, who seeks the truth; and I will pardon her.

title: Jeremiah 5:2
text: And though they say, [As] the LORD lives; surely they swear falsely.

title: Jeremiah 5:3
text: O LORD, [are] not Your eyes on the truth? You have stricken them, but they have not grieved; You have destroyed them, but they have refused to receive correction; they have made their faces harder than rock; they have refused to return.

title: Jeremiah 5:4
text: So I said, Surely these [are] poor; they are foolish; for they do not know the way of the LORD, [nor] the judgment of their God.

title: Jeremiah 5:5
text: I will go up for myself to the great men, and will speak to them; for they have known the way of the LORD [and] the judgment of their God. But these have broken the yoke together and have torn off the bonds!

title: Jeremiah 5:6
text: Therefore a lion out of the forest shall kill them, [and] a wolf of the deserts shall rob them; a leopard shall watch over their cities. Everyone who goes out from them shall be torn in pieces, because their sins are many [and] their backslidings are multiplied.

title: Jeremiah 5:7
text: Why shall I pardon you for this? Your sons have forsaken Me, and have sworn by No-gods. When I adjured them, then they committed adultery, and gathered themselves by troops in a harlot's house.

title: Jeremiah 5:8
text: They were [like] lusty, well-fed stallions in the morning; every one neighing after his neighbor's wife.

title: Jeremiah 5:9
text: Shall I not judge for these [things]? says the LORD. And shall not My soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 5:10
text: Go up on her vine-rows and destroy; but do not make a full end; take away her branches, for they [are] not the LORD's.

title: Jeremiah 5:11
text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very deceitfully against Me, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 5:12
text: They have lied against the LORD and said, [It is] not He; neither shall evil come on us; nor shall we see sword nor famine.

title: Jeremiah 5:13
text: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word [is] not in them; so it shall be done to them.

title: Jeremiah 5:14
text: Therefore so says the LORD God of hosts, Because you spoke this word, behold, I will make My words in your mouth fire, and these people wood, and it shall devour them.

title: Jeremiah 5:15
text: Lo, I will bring a nation on you from afar, O house of Israel, says the LORD. It [is] an enduring nation, it [is] an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know, nor understand what they say.

title: Jeremiah 5:16
text: Their quiver [is] as an open grave; they [are] all mighty men.

title: Jeremiah 5:17
text: And they shall eat up your harvest, and your bread. They will devour your sons and your daughters. They shall eat up your flocks and your herds; they shall eat up your vines and your fig-trees. One shall beat down your fortified cities with the sword, those in which you trust.

title: Jeremiah 5:18
text: But even in those days, says the LORD, I will not make a complete end with you.

title: Jeremiah 5:19
text: And it will be, when you shall say, Why does the LORD our God do all these to us? Then You shall answer them, Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you shall serve strangers in a land not yours.

title: Jeremiah 5:20
text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and cry it in Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 5:21
text: Now hear this, O foolish people and without heart; who have eyes and see not; who have ears and hear not;

title: Jeremiah 5:22
text: Do you not fear Me? says the LORD. Will you not tremble at My presence, I who have placed the sand [for] the boundary of the sea [by] a never-ending decree, so that it cannot pass it? And though they toss themselves, yet they cannot prevail; though its waves roar, yet they cannot pass over it?

title: Jeremiah 5:23
text: But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart; they have revolted and are gone.

title: Jeremiah 5:24
text: And they do not say in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, who gives both the former and the latter rain in its season; He reserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

title: Jeremiah 5:25
text: Your iniquities have turned away these [things], and your sins have withheld good from you.

title: Jeremiah 5:26
text: For among My people are found wicked ones; they lie in wait, as one who sets snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

title: Jeremiah 5:27
text: Like a cage full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have become great and grown rich.

title: Jeremiah 5:28
text: They have become fat, they shine. Yes, they go past the deeds of the wicked; they do not judge the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may get rich; and they do not judge the right of the needy.

title: Jeremiah 5:29
text: Shall I not visit for these [things]? says the LORD. Shall not My soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 5:30
text: An astounding and horrible thing has happened in the land.

title: Jeremiah 5:31
text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love [to have it] so, and what will you do at the end of it?

title: Jeremiah 6:1
text: O sons of Benjamin, take refuge out of the midst of Jerusalem. And blow the ram's horn in Tekoa, and set up a signal-fire over Beth-haccerem; for evil appears out of the north, and great ruin.

title: Jeremiah 6:2
text: I will destroy the daughter of Zion, the beautiful and tender one.

title: Jeremiah 6:3
text: The shepherds with their flocks shall come to her; they shall pitch tents on her all around; they shall feed each one [in] his hand.

title: Jeremiah 6:4
text: Prepare war against her; arise and let us go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

title: Jeremiah 6:5
text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

title: Jeremiah 6:6
text: For so has the LORD of hosts said, Cut down trees and cast a mound against Jerusalem! She [is] the city to be visited; [there is] nothing but oppression in her midst.

title: Jeremiah 6:7
text: As a fountain keeps fresh her waters, so she keeps fresh her evil; violence and spoil is heard in her; always before Me [are] grief and wounds.

title: Jeremiah 6:8
text: O Jerusalem, you must be instructed, lest My soul depart from you; lest I make you desolate, a land without people.

title: Jeremiah 6:9
text: So says the LORD of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine; turn back your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.

title: Jeremiah 6:10
text: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? Behold, their ears [are] not circumcised, and they cannot listen. Behold, the word of the LORD is to them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

title: Jeremiah 6:11
text: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in; I will pour it out on the children in the street, and on the circle of young men together. For even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with fullness of days.

title: Jeremiah 6:12
text: And their houses shall be turned to others, together [with their] fields and wives; for I will stretch out My hand on the people of the land, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 6:13
text: For everyone from the least of them even to the greatest of them cuts off a profit; and from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

title: Jeremiah 6:14
text: They have also healed the hurt [of the daughter] of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace, when [there is] no peace.

title: Jeremiah 6:15
text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, nor could they blush; therefore they shall fall among those who fall. At the time [that] I visit them they shall be cast down, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 6:16
text: So says the LORD, Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths where the good way [is], and walk in it, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk [in it].

title: Jeremiah 6:17
text: Also I set watchmen over you, [saying], Listen to the sound of the ram's horn. But they said, We will not listen.

title: Jeremiah 6:18
text: Therefore hear, nations, and know, O congregation, what [is] among them.

title: Jeremiah 6:19
text: Hear, O earth; behold, I will bring evil on this people, the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to My words, nor to My law, but have rejected it.

title: Jeremiah 6:20
text: Why does frankincense come to me from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings [are] not pleasing, nor your sacrifices sweet to Me.

title: Jeremiah 6:21
text: Therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumbling-blocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall on them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 6:22
text: So says the LORD, Behold, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be stirred from the sides of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 6:23
text: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they [are] cruel and have no mercy; their voice roars like the sea; and they ride on horses, set in order like a man for war against you, O daughter of Zion.

title: Jeremiah 6:24
text: We have heard the rumor of it; our hands become feeble; anguish has taken hold of us, pain, like a woman in labor.

title: Jeremiah 6:25
text: Do not go out into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy [and] fear [are] on every side.

title: Jeremiah 6:26
text: O daughter of my people, put on sackcloth, and wallow in ashes; make mourning for yourself, [as for] an only son, most bitter weeping; for the ravager shall suddenly come on us.

title: Jeremiah 6:27
text: I have set you up an assayer, an examiner among My people, that you may know and try their way.

title: Jeremiah 6:28
text: They [are] all grievous revolters, walking [in] slanders; they [are] bronze and iron; they [are] all corrupters.

title: Jeremiah 6:29
text: The bellows are burned, the lead is melted by the fire; the. refiner melts in vain; for the wicked are not plucked away.

title: Jeremiah 6:30
text: Reprobate silver they call them, because the LORD has rejected them.

title: Jeremiah 7:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 7:2
text: Stand in the gate of the LORD's house, and declare there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 7:3
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Make your ways and your doings good, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

title: Jeremiah 7:4
text: Do not trust in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD [are] these.

title: Jeremiah 7:5
text: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if you completely do judgment between a man and his neighbor;

title: Jeremiah 7:6
text: [if] you do not oppress the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, nor walk after other gods to your hurt;

title: Jeremiah 7:7
text: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, forever and ever.

title: Jeremiah 7:8
text: Behold, you trust in lying words that cannot do any good.

title: Jeremiah 7:9
text: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods whom you do not know;

title: Jeremiah 7:10
text: and then come and stand before Me in this house which is called by My name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

title: Jeremiah 7:11
text: Has this house, which is called by My name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I also have seen, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 7:12
text: But go now to My place which [was] in Shiloh, where I set My name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of My people Israel.

title: Jeremiah 7:13
text: And now, because you have done all these works, says the LORD, and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you did not hear; and I called you, but you did not answer;

title: Jeremiah 7:14
text: therefore I will do to [this] house, which is called by My name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

title: Jeremiah 7:15
text: And I will cast you out of My sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, the whole seed of Ephraim.

title: Jeremiah 7:16
text: Therefore do not pray for this people, nor lift up cry nor prayer for them, nor make intercession to Me; for I will not hear you.

title: Jeremiah 7:17
text: Do you not see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

title: Jeremiah 7:18
text: The sons gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke Me to anger.

title: Jeremiah 7:19
text: Do they vex Me? says the LORD. [Is it] not themselves to the shame of their own faces?

title: Jeremiah 7:20
text: Therefore so says the Lord GOD; Behold, My anger and My fury shall be poured out on this place, on man, and on animal, and on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be put out.

title: Jeremiah 7:21
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Put your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

title: Jeremiah 7:22
text: For I did not speak to your fathers, nor command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices.

title: Jeremiah 7:23
text: But I commanded them this thing, saying, Obey My voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be My people; and walk in all the ways that I have commanded you, so that it may be well with you.

title: Jeremiah 7:24
text: But they did not listen, nor bow their ear, but walked in [their own] plans, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward and not forward.

title: Jeremiah 7:25
text: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day I have even sent to you all My servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending.

title: Jeremiah 7:26
text: Yet they did not listen to Me, nor bow down their ear, but hardened their neck. They did worse than their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 7:27
text: So you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; you shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

title: Jeremiah 7:28
text: But you shall say to them, This [is] a nation which does not obey the voice of the LORD their God, nor receives instruction; truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

title: Jeremiah 7:29
text: Cut off your hair and throw [it] away, and take up a weeping on the high places. For the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.

title: Jeremiah 7:30
text: For the sons of Judah have done evil in My sight, says the LORD. They have set their abominations in the house which is called by My name, in order to defile it.

title: Jeremiah 7:31
text: They have built the high places of Tophet, which [is] in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I did not command [them], nor did it come into My heart.

title: Jeremiah 7:32
text: So, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they shall bury in Tophet, until there is no place.

title: Jeremiah 7:33
text: And the bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten [them] away.

title: Jeremiah 7:34
text: Then I will cause the voice of gladness to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride. For the land shall be desolate.

title: Jeremiah 8:1
text: At that time, says the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its rulers, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

title: Jeremiah 8:2
text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of the heavens, whom they have loved and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshiped. They shall not be gathered nor buried; they shall be as dung on the face of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 8:3
text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the rest of those who remain of this evil family, who remain in all the places where I have driven them, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 8:4
text: And you shall say to them, So says the LORD; shall they fall and not arise? Shall he turn away and not return?

title: Jeremiah 8:5
text: Why has this people of Jerusalem slidden back [by] a never-ending backsliding? They hold fast to deceit; they refuse to return.

title: Jeremiah 8:6
text: I listened and heard, [but] they did not speak right; no man repented of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? Everyone turned to their own courses own way, as the horse rushes into the battle.

title: Jeremiah 8:7
text: Yea, the stork in the heavens knows her seasons; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow watch the time of their coming; but my people do not know the judgment of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 8:8
text: How do you say, We [are] wise, and the law of the LORD [is] with us? Lo, certainly the lying pen of the scribes has written falsely.

title: Jeremiah 8:9
text: The wise are ashamed, they are terrified, and are captured. Lo, they have turned away from the word of the LORD; and what wisdom [is] in them?

title: Jeremiah 8:10
text: Therefore I will give their wives to others, [and] their fields to those who shall inherit [them], for everyone from the least even to the greatest cuts off a profit. From the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

title: Jeremiah 8:11
text: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of My people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when [there is] no peace.

title: Jeremiah 8:12
text: Were they ashamed when they had done an abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, nor could they blush; therefore they shall fall among those who fall; in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 8:13
text: I will utterly consume them, says the LORD; [there shall be] no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them, [those who] pass over them.

title: Jeremiah 8:14
text: Why do we sit still? Gather yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there. For the LORD our God has put us to silence, and has given us poisonous water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 8:15
text: We looked for peace, but no good [came]; [and] for a time of health, but behold, trouble!

title: Jeremiah 8:16
text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan; the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his stallions. For they have come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those who live in it.

title: Jeremiah 8:17
text: For, behold, I will send serpents and adders among you, [which will] not [be] charmed; and they shall bite you, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 8:18
text: [When] I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart [is] faint within me.

title: Jeremiah 8:19
text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people, from a far country. [Is] not the LORD in Zion? [Is] not her King in her? Why have they provoked Me with their graven images, with foreign vanities?

title: Jeremiah 8:20
text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

title: Jeremiah 8:21
text: For the breaking of the daughter of my people I am broken; I am in gloom; horror has seized me.

title: Jeremiah 8:22
text: [Is there] no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the healing of the daughter of My people not come?

title: Jeremiah 9:1
text: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

title: Jeremiah 9:2
text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place for traveling men, that I might leave my people and go away from them! For they [are] all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

title: Jeremiah 9:3
text: And they bend their tongues [like] their bow [for] lies. But they are not mighty for the truth on the earth; for they go from evil to evil, and they do not know Me, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 9:4
text: Everyone beware of his neighbor, and do not trust any brother! For every brother will supplant his neighbor, and will walk with slanders.

title: Jeremiah 9:5
text: And everyone will deceive his neighbor and will not speak the truth; they have taught their tongue to speak lies, [and] they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

title: Jeremiah 9:6
text: Your dwelling [is] in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know Me, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 9:7
text: Therefore so says the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them and try them; for what [else] can I do for the daughter of My people?

title: Jeremiah 9:8
text: Their tongue [is] a slaughtering arrow; it speaks deceit; [one] speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in heart he lies in ambush.

title: Jeremiah 9:9
text: Shall I not visit them for these [things]? says the LORD; shall not My soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 9:10
text: I will take up a weeping and a wailing for the mountains, and a mourning for the pastures of the wilderness; because they are burned up, so that none can pass through [them]; nor can men hear the voice of the cattle. Both the birds of the heavens and the beast have fled; they are gone.

title: Jeremiah 9:11
text: And I will make Jerusalem ruins, a den of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without a living soul.

title: Jeremiah 9:12
text: Who [is] the wise man who may understand this? And who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why does the land perish [and] burn up like a wilderness, so that none passes through?

title: Jeremiah 9:13
text: And the LORD says, Because they have forsaken My law which I set before them, and have not obeyed My voice, and have not walked in it,

title: Jeremiah 9:14
text: but they have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.

title: Jeremiah 9:15
text: Therefore so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and make them drink poisonous water.

title: Jeremiah 9:16
text: I will also scatter them among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. And I will send a sword after them until I have consumed them.

title: Jeremiah 9:17
text: So says the LORD of hosts, Think carefully, and call for the wailers, that they may come. And send for the wise women, that they may come;

title: Jeremiah 9:18
text: and let them make haste and take up a weeping for us, so that our eyes may run down with tears, and waters flow [from] our eyelids.

title: Jeremiah 9:19
text: For a voice of weeping is heard out of Zion. How are we plundered! We are greatly ashamed, because we have forsaken the land, because they have thrown down our tents.

title: Jeremiah 9:20
text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O women, and let your ear receive the word of His mouth, and teach your daughters to weep, and each one teach her neighbor to mourn.

title: Jeremiah 9:21
text: For death has come up into our windows, [and] has entered into our houses, to cut off the children from outside [and] the young men from the streets.

title: Jeremiah 9:22
text: Speak, So says the LORD, Even the bodies of men shall fall as dung on the open field, and as the fallen grain after the reaper; and none shall gather [them].

title: Jeremiah 9:23
text: So says the LORD, Do not let the wise glory in his wisdom, nor let the mighty glory in his might; do not let the rich glory in his riches;

title: Jeremiah 9:24
text: but let him who glories glory in this, that he understands and knows Me, that I [am] the LORD, doing kindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth; for in these I delight, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 9:25
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will punish all the circumcised with foreskin;

title: Jeremiah 9:26
text: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the sons of Ammon, and Moab, and all [who are] in the outermost corners, who dwell in the wilderness. For all [these] nations are not circumcised, and all the house of Israel, those not circumcised in heart.

title: Jeremiah 10:1
text: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 10:2
text: So says the LORD, Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be terrified at the signs of the heavens; for the nations are terrified at them.

title: Jeremiah 10:3
text: For the customs of the people [are] vain; for one cuts a tree out of the forest with the axe, the work of the hands of the workman.

title: Jeremiah 10:4
text: They adorn it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and hammers, so that it will not wobble.

title: Jeremiah 10:5
text: They [are] like a rounded post, and they cannot speak. They must surely be lifted, because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them; for they cannot do evil nor good, for it is not in them.

title: Jeremiah 10:6
text: [There is] none like You, O LORD; You [are] great, and Your name [is] great in might.

title: Jeremiah 10:7
text: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? For fear belongs to You, because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, [there is] none like You.

title: Jeremiah 10:8
text: But they are all at once foolish and animal-like; the tree [is] an example of vanities.

title: Jeremiah 10:9
text: Silver beaten into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the goldsmith. Violet and purple [is] their clothing; they [are] all the work of skillful ones.

title: Jeremiah 10:10
text: But the LORD [is] the true God, He [is] the living God, and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to stand His fury.

title: Jeremiah 10:11
text: So you shall say to them, The gods who have not made the heavens and the earth, they shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens.

title: Jeremiah 10:12
text: He has made the earth by His power; He has established the world by His wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by His judgment.

title: Jeremiah 10:13
text: When He utters His voice, [there is] a noise of many waters in the heavens. He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of His treasures.

title: Jeremiah 10:14
text: Every man is stupid for [lack of] knowledge; every refiner is put to shame by the graven image; for his molten image is a lie, and no breath is in them.

title: Jeremiah 10:15
text: They [are] vanity, the work of delusion; in the time of their judgment they shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 10:16
text: The Portion of Jacob [is] not like them; for He [is] the Maker of all things; and Israel [is] the rod of His inheritance. The LORD of hosts [is] His name.

title: Jeremiah 10:17
text: Gather up your bundle from the ground, you who live under the siege.

title: Jeremiah 10:18
text: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the people of the land at this time, and will distress them, so that they may find [Me].

title: Jeremiah 10:19
text: Woe [to] me for my breaking! My wound is grievous; but I said, Truly this [is] a malady, and I must bear it.

title: Jeremiah 10:20
text: My tabernacle is ravaged, and all my cords are broken; My sons went away from me, and they [are] not. [There is] none to stretch out My tabernacle any more, and to set up My curtains.

title: Jeremiah 10:21
text: For the pastors have become stupid, and have not sought the LORD, therefore they shall not be blessed, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

title: Jeremiah 10:22
text: Behold, the noise of the rumor has come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a den of jackals.

title: Jeremiah 10:23
text: O LORD, I know that the way of man does not [belong] to man; [it is] not in man who walks to direct his steps.

title: Jeremiah 10:24
text: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in Your anger, lest You bring me to nothing.

title: Jeremiah 10:25
text: Pour out Your fury on the nations who do not know You, and on the families who do not call on Your name; for they have eaten up Jacob and have devoured him, and have destroyed him, and have made his dwelling desolate.

title: Jeremiah 11:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD saying,

title: Jeremiah 11:2
text: Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the people of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 11:3
text: And say to them, So says the LORD God of Israel, Cursed [is] the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,

title: Jeremiah 11:4
text: which I commanded your fathers in the day [that] I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey My voice and do them according to all that I command you; so you shall be My people, and I will be your God;

title: Jeremiah 11:5
text: so that I may fulfil the oath which I have sworn to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as [it is] this day. Then I answered and said, Amen, O LORD.

title: Jeremiah 11:6
text: Then the LORD said to me, Declare all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

title: Jeremiah 11:7
text: For I earnestly testified to your fathers in the day I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and testifying, saying, Obey My voice.

title: Jeremiah 11:8
text: Yet they did not obey nor bow down their ear, but walked each one in the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I will bring on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded [them] to do; but they did not do them.

title: Jeremiah 11:9
text: And the LORD said to me, A plot is found among the men of Judah, and among the people of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 11:10
text: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear My words. And they went after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 11:11
text: So the LORD says this: Behold, I will bring evil on them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry to Me, I will not listen to them.

title: Jeremiah 11:12
text: Then shall the cities of Judah and the people of Jerusalem go and cry to the gods to whom they offer incense. But they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

title: Jeremiah 11:13
text: For [according to] the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah. And [according to] the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to [that] shameful thing, altars to burn incense to Baal.

title: Jeremiah 11:14
text: And you, do not pray for this people, nor lift up a cry or prayer for them. For I will not hear [them] in the time they cry to Me for their trouble.

title: Jeremiah 11:15
text: What [is to] My beloved in My house, [since] she has committed her many evils? And has the holy flesh caused your evil to pass from you? [How] then do you exult?

title: Jeremiah 11:16
text: The LORD called your name, a green olive tree, fair, [with] fine fruit. With the sound of a great storm He has set fire to it, and its branches are worthless.

title: Jeremiah 11:17
text: And the LORD of hosts who planted you has spoken evil against you, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves to provoke Me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

title: Jeremiah 11:18
text: And the LORD made me know, and I knew. Then You showed me their doings.

title: Jeremiah 11:19
text: But I [was] like a docile lamb being brought to the slaughter. And I did not know that they had plotted evils against me, [saying], Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, so that his name may be remembered no more.

title: Jeremiah 11:20
text: But, O LORD of hosts who judges rightly, who tries the heart and the mind, let me see Your vengeance on them. For to You I have revealed my cause.

title: Jeremiah 11:21
text: Therefore so says the LORD of the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD, that you do not die by our hand.

title: Jeremiah 11:22
text: So says LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them. The young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;

title: Jeremiah 11:23
text: and there shall be no remnant of them. For I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, the year of their judgment.

title: Jeremiah 12:1
text: Righteous [are] You, O LORD, that I might contend with You; yet let me speak with You about [Your] judgments. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? [Why] are all [those] happy who deal treacherously?

title: Jeremiah 12:2
text: You have planted them; yea, they take root. They grow, yea, they make fruit. You [are] near in their mouth and far from their reins.

title: Jeremiah 12:3
text: But You, O LORD, know me. You have seen me and tried my heart toward You. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and devote them for the day of slaughter.

title: Jeremiah 12:4
text: How long shall the land mourn, and the grass of every field wither from the evil of those who dwell in it? The beasts and the birds have been destroyed, because they said, He shall not see our last end.

title: Jeremiah 12:5
text: If you have run with footmen, and they wore you out, then how can you compete with horses? And [if] you feel secure in the land of peace, then how will you do in the swelling of Jordan?

title: Jeremiah 12:6
text: For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you. Yea, they have called a multitude after you. Do not believe them, though they speak good things to you.

title: Jeremiah 12:7
text: I have forsaken My house; I have left My inheritance. I have given the dearly beloved of My soul into the hand of her enemies.

title: Jeremiah 12:8
text: My inheritance is to Me as a lion in the forest; it cries out against Me; therefore I have hated it.

title: Jeremiah 12:9
text: My inheritance [is like] a speckled bird to Me; the birds all around [are] against her. Go, gather all the beasts of the field, bring them to devour.

title: Jeremiah 12:10
text: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My portion under foot; they have made My pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 12:11
text: One has made it a desolation, it mourns to Me. The whole land is made desolate because no man lays [it] to heart.

title: Jeremiah 12:12
text: The ravagers have come on all high places through the wilderness; for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the [one] end of the land even to the [other] end of the land. No flesh shall have peace.

title: Jeremiah 12:13
text: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns. They are worn out, [but] they do not profit. And they shall be ashamed of your harvests because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 12:14
text: So says the LORD against all My evil neighbors who touch the inheritance which I have caused My people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

title: Jeremiah 12:15
text: And it will be after I have plucked them out, I will return and have pity on them, and will bring them again, each man to his inheritance and each man to his land.

title: Jeremiah 12:16
text: And it will be if they will carefully learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, [As] the LORD lives; as they taught the people to swear by Baal; then they shall be built in the midst of My people.

title: Jeremiah 12:17
text: But if they will not obey, I will uproot and destroy that nation, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 13:1
text: So says the LORD to me, Go and buy for yourself a linen girdle, and put it on your loins, and do not put [it] in water.

title: Jeremiah 13:2
text: So I bought a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put [it] on my loins.

title: Jeremiah 13:3
text: And the word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying,

title: Jeremiah 13:4
text: Take the girdle that you bought, which [is] on your loins, and arise. Go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

title: Jeremiah 13:5
text: So I went and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

title: Jeremiah 13:6
text: And it happened at the end of many days the LORD said to me, Arise, go to Euphrates and take the girdle from there, which I commanded you to hide there.

title: Jeremiah 13:7
text: Then I went to Euphrates and dug, and took the girdle from the place where I had hidden it. And, behold, the girdle was rotted; it was not good for anything.

title: Jeremiah 13:8
text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 13:9
text: So says the LORD, In this way I will spoil the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 13:10
text: This evil people, who refuse to hear My words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart and walk after other gods to serve them and to worship them, shall even be like this girdle, which is good for nothing.

title: Jeremiah 13:11
text: For as the girdle holds fast to the loins of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to Me, says the LORD; so that they might be to Me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory; but they would not hear.

title: Jeremiah 13:12
text: So you will speak to them this word: So says the LORD God of Israel, Every skin shall be filled with wine. And they shall say to you, Do we not surely know that every skin shall be filled with wine?

title: Jeremiah 13:13
text: Then you shall say to them, So says the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the people of this land, even the kings that sit on David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

title: Jeremiah 13:14
text: And I will smash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says the LORD. I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, [to keep them] from their destruction.

title: Jeremiah 13:15
text: Hear and give ear; do not be proud; for the LORD has spoken.

title: Jeremiah 13:16
text: Give glory to the LORD your God, before He causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, He turns it into the shadow of death, setting up deep gloom.

title: Jeremiah 13:17
text: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for [your] pride. And my eye shall weep sore and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock was captured.

title: Jeremiah 13:18
text: Say to the king and to the queen mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your greatness shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

title: Jeremiah 13:19
text: The cities of the south have been shut up, and none are opening; Judah has been exiled, all of it has been peacefully exiled.

title: Jeremiah 13:20
text: Lift up your eyes and behold those who come from the north. Where [is] the flock [that] was given to you, your beautiful flock?

title: Jeremiah 13:21
text: What will you say when he comes to punish you? For you have taught them [to be] rulers over you for a head. Do not pangs seize you, like a woman in travail?

title: Jeremiah 13:22
text: And if you say in your heart, Why do these things come on me? [It is] because of the greatness of your iniquity; your skirts are bared, [and] your heels suffer violence.

title: Jeremiah 13:23
text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard its spots? [Then] you also may do good, who are accustomed to doing evil.

title: Jeremiah 13:24
text: And I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 13:25
text: This [is] your lot, the share I have measured to you, says the LORD, because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.

title: Jeremiah 13:26
text: So I also have stripped off your skirts over your face, that your shame may appear.

title: Jeremiah 13:27
text: I have seen your adulteries, and your neighings, the wickedness of your fornication, [and] your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! Will you not be made clean? How long [will it] still [be]?

title: Jeremiah 14:1
text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the matter of droughts.

title: Jeremiah 14:2
text: Judah mourns, and its gates droop. They are black to the ground, and the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.

title: Jeremiah 14:3
text: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters; they came to the cisterns, [and] found no water. They returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

title: Jeremiah 14:4
text: Because the ground was cracked, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed; they covered their heads.

title: Jeremiah 14:5
text: Yea, the doe also calved in the field and forsook [it], because [there was] no grass.

title: Jeremiah 14:6
text: And the wild asses stood in the high places; they snuffed up the wind like jackals; their eyes failed because [there was] no grass.

title: Jeremiah 14:7
text: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, act for Your name's sake; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against You.

title: Jeremiah 14:8
text: O the Hope of Israel, its Savior in time of trouble, why should You be as a stranger in the land, and as a traveler turning in to lodge?

title: Jeremiah 14:9
text: Why should You be as a man stunned, as one mighty, [yet] who cannot save? Yet You, O LORD, [are] in our midst, and we are called by Your name. Do not leave us!

title: Jeremiah 14:10
text: So says the LORD to this people; So they have loved to wander; they have not restrained their feet; therefore the LORD does not accept them. He will now remember their iniquity and visit their sins.

title: Jeremiah 14:11
text: Then the LORD said to me, Do not pray for this people for good.

title: Jeremiah 14:12
text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and a grain offering, I will not accept them. But I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague.

title: Jeremiah 14:13
text: Then I said, Ah, O Lord Jehovah! Behold, the prophets are saying to them, You shall not see the sword, nor shall you have famine; but I will give you true peace in this place.

title: Jeremiah 14:14
text: And the LORD said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in My name; I did not send them, nor have I commanded them, nor did I speak to them. They prophesy to you a false vision and a worthless divination, and a thing of no value, and the deceit of their heart.

title: Jeremiah 14:15
text: So the LORD says this concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name, and I did not send them; yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; by sword and famine those prophets shall be consumed.

title: Jeremiah 14:16
text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, [either] them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters. For I will pour their evil on them.

title: Jeremiah 14:17
text: And you shall speak this word to them: Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and do not let them cease. For the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great break, [with] a very grievous blow.

title: Jeremiah 14:18
text: If I go out into the field, then I see those killed with the sword! And if I enter into the city, then, behold, sicknesses of famine! Yes, both the prophet and the priest have gone up into a land that they do not know.

title: Jeremiah 14:19
text: Have You utterly rejected Judah? Or has Your soul hated Zion? Why have You stricken us, and [there is] no healing for us? [We] looked for peace, but no good [came]; and for the time of healing, and behold, trouble!

title: Jeremiah 14:20
text: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against You.

title: Jeremiah 14:21
text: Do not abhor [us] for Your name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of Your glory; remember, do not break Your covenant with us.

title: Jeremiah 14:22
text: Are there [any] among the vanities of the nations who make rain fall? Or can the heavens give showers? [Is] it not You, O LORD our God? Then we will wait on You; for You do all these things.

title: Jeremiah 15:1
text: Then the LORD said to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before Me, My soul [could] not [be] toward this people. Send [them] out of My sight, and let them go out.

title: Jeremiah 15:2
text: And it will be, if they say to you, Where shall we go? Then you shall tell them, So says the LORD: Those who [are] for death, go to death; and those for the sword, to the sword; and those for the famine, to the famine; and those for the captivity, to the captivity.

title: Jeremiah 15:3
text: And I will set over them four kinds, says the LORD; the sword to kill, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of the heaven and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

title: Jeremiah 15:4
text: And I will make them a horror to all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 15:5
text: For who shall have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Or who shall weep over you? Or who shall turn aside to ask your welfare?

title: Jeremiah 15:6
text: You have forsaken Me, says the LORD; you have gone backward; therefore I will stretch out My hand against you, and destroy you; I am weary with repenting.

title: Jeremiah 15:7
text: And I will winnow them with a fork in the gates of the land; I will bereave [them] of sons; I will destroy My people, since they do not turn from their ways.

title: Jeremiah 15:8
text: Their widows are more numerous about Me than the sand of the seas; I have brought on them, against a mother of a young man, a ravager at noonday; I have caused anguish and terror to fall on her suddenly.

title: Jeremiah 15:9
text: She who bore seven languishes; she has breathed out her life; her sun has gone down while [it was] yet day. She has been ashamed and humiliated; and I will deliver the rest of them to the sword before their enemies, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 15:10
text: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not loaned, nor have men loaned to me; [yet] every one curses me.

title: Jeremiah 15:11
text: The LORD said, Truly I will free you for good. Truly I will cause the enemy to entreat you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

title: Jeremiah 15:12
text: Can one break iron, iron or bronze from the north?

title: Jeremiah 15:13
text: Your wealth and your treasures I will give for prey, not for price, [but] for all your sins, even in all your borders.

title: Jeremiah 15:14
text: And I will make [you] pass with your enemies into a land [which] you do not know. For a fire has been kindled in My anger; it shall burn against you.

title: Jeremiah 15:15
text: O LORD, You know; remember me and visit me, and take vengeance for me on those who seek to hurt me. Do not take me away in Your long-suffering; know that for Your sake I have suffered rebuke.

title: Jeremiah 15:16
text: Your words were found, and I ate them; and Your Word was to me the joy and gladness of my heart; for I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 15:17
text: I did not sit in the circle of mockers, nor rejoice; I sat alone because of Your hand; for You have filled me with indignation.

title: Jeremiah 15:18
text: Why has my pain been without end, and why is my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? You surely are to me like a deceitful brook, waters that cannot be trusted.

title: Jeremiah 15:19
text: Therefore so says the LORD, If you turn back, then I will bring you again; you shall stand before Me. And if you take the precious from the worthless, you shall be as My mouth. Let them turn back to you, but do not return to them.

title: Jeremiah 15:20
text: And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; and they shall fight against you, but they shall not overcome you; for I [am] with you to save you and to deliver you, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 15:21
text: And I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the evil ones.

title: Jeremiah 16:1
text: The word of the LORD was to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 16:2
text: You shall not take a wife for yourself, nor shall you have sons or daughters in this place.

title: Jeremiah 16:3
text: For so says the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who fathered them in this land:

title: Jeremiah 16:4
text: They shall die from deaths of diseases; they shall not be mourned, nor shall they be buried. [But] they shall be as dung on the face of the earth. And they shall be destroyed by the sword and by famine; and their bodies shall be food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 16:5
text: For so says the LORD, Do not enter into the house of mourning; do not go to weep nor moan over them. For I have taken away My peace from this people, says the LORD, even loving-kindness and mercies.

title: Jeremiah 16:6
text: Both the great and the small shall die in this land. They shall not be buried, nor shall [men] mourn for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them.

title: Jeremiah 16:7
text: Nor shall [anyone] tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Nor shall [anyone] give them the cup of comfort to drink for their father or for their mother.

title: Jeremiah 16:8
text: Also you shall not go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

title: Jeremiah 16:9
text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause the voice of mirth to cease out of this place [before] your eyes, and in your days, and the voice of gladness, and the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

title: Jeremiah 16:10
text: And it shall be, when you declare to this people all these words, and they shall say to you, Why has the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? Or what [is] our iniquity, or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?

title: Jeremiah 16:11
text: Then you shall say to them, Because your fathers have forsaken Me, says the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshiped them, and have forsaken Me, and have not kept My law.

title: Jeremiah 16:12
text: And you have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, you walk each one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, without listening to Me;

title: Jeremiah 16:13
text: even I will cast you out of this land into a land that you do not know, [neither] you nor your fathers; and there you shall serve other gods day and night; where I will not grant you favor.

title: Jeremiah 16:14
text: So, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that it shall no more be said, [As] the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

title: Jeremiah 16:15
text: but, [As] the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands where He had driven them. And I will bring them again into their lands that I gave to their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 16:16
text: Behold, I will send for many fishermen, says the LORD, and they will fish them. And afterwards I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

title: Jeremiah 16:17
text: For My eyes [are] on all their ways; they are not hidden from My face, nor is their iniquity hidden from My eyes.

title: Jeremiah 16:18
text: And first I will twice repay their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled My land, they have filled My inheritance with the dead bodies of their abominable things.

title: Jeremiah 16:19
text: O LORD, my strength and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations shall come to You from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and there is no profit in them.

title: Jeremiah 16:20
text: Shall a man make gods to himself, and they [are] no gods?

title: Jeremiah 16:21
text: Therefore, behold, I will make them know; this time I will cause them to know My hand and My might; and they shall know that My name [is] Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 17:1
text: The sin of Judah [is] engraved with an iron stylus; [it is] carved on the tablet of the heart and on the horns of Your altar with the point of a diamond;

title: Jeremiah 17:2
text: while their sons remember their altars and their Asherahs by the green trees on the high hills.

title: Jeremiah 17:3
text: O My mountain in the field, I will give your wealth [and] all your treasures for prey, and your high places for sin, throughout all your borders.

title: Jeremiah 17:4
text: And you, even through yourself, have let go of the inheritance which I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in a land which you do not know. For you have kindled a fire in My anger, [which] shall burn forever.

title: Jeremiah 17:5
text: So says the LORD, Cursed [is] the man who trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 17:6
text: For he shall be like a juniper in the desert, and shall not see when good comes. But he shall live in the parched places in the wilderness, [in] a salt land that is not inhabited.

title: Jeremiah 17:7
text: Blessed [is] the man who trusts in the LORD, and Jehovah is his trust.

title: Jeremiah 17:8
text: For he shall be like a tree planted by the waters; [it] sends out its roots by the river, and [it] shall not fear when the heat comes, but its foliage shall be green; and he is not worried in the year of drought, nor will it cease from yielding fruit.

title: Jeremiah 17:9
text: The heart [is] deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked; who can know it?

title: Jeremiah 17:10
text: I the LORD search the heart, [I] try the reins, even to give to each man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.

title: Jeremiah 17:11
text: The quail sits [on eggs] and does not hatch [them]; in the same way he who gets riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the middle of his days, and in his end he shall be a fool.

title: Jeremiah 17:12
text: A glorious high throne from the beginning [is] the place of our sanctuary.

title: Jeremiah 17:13
text: O LORD, the Hope of Israel, all who forsake You shall be ashamed. Those who depart from Me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the Fountain of living waters.

title: Jeremiah 17:14
text: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed, save me, and I shall be saved; for You [are] my praise.

title: Jeremiah 17:15
text: Behold, they say to me, Where [is] the word of the LORD? Let it come now!

title: Jeremiah 17:16
text: I have not hurried away from shepherding after You; nor have I desired the woeful day; You surely know the going forth of my lips before Your face.

title: Jeremiah 17:17
text: Do not be a terror to me; You [are] my hope in the day of evil.

title: Jeremiah 17:18
text: Let those who persecute me be ashamed, but do not let me be ashamed; let them be afraid, but do not let me be afraid. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them [with] double breaking.

title: Jeremiah 17:19
text: So the LORD said to me: Go and stand in the gates of the sons of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 17:20
text: And say to them, Hear the word of the LORD, kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the people of Jerusalem who enter in by these gates!

title: Jeremiah 17:21
text: So says the LORD, Take heed to yourselves, and carry no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring [it] in by the gates of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 17:22
text: Nor carry out a burden from your houses on the Sabbath day, nor do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 17:23
text: But they did not obey, nor bowed down their ear, but made their neck stiff, so that they might not hear nor receive instruction.

title: Jeremiah 17:24
text: And it shall be, if you carefully listen to Me, says the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but keep the Sabbath day holy, to do no work in it;

title: Jeremiah 17:25
text: then kings and rulers sitting on the throne of David shall enter into the gates of this city, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their rulers, the men of Judah, and the people of Jerusalem. And this city shall remain forever.

title: Jeremiah 17:26
text: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and grain offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise to the house of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 17:27
text: But if you will not listen to me to keep the Sabbath day holy, and not to carry a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it will not be put out.

title: Jeremiah 18:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 18:2
text: Arise and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear My words.

title: Jeremiah 18:3
text: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he was working a work on the wheel.

title: Jeremiah 18:4
text: And the vessel that he made in clay was ruined in the hand of the potter; so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make [it].

title: Jeremiah 18:5
text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 18:6
text: O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter? says the LORD. Behold, As the clay in the potter's hands, [so are] you in My hand, O house of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 18:7
text: The instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck it up and to pull it down, and to destroy [it];

title: Jeremiah 18:8
text: if that nation, against whom I have spoken, will turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

title: Jeremiah 18:9
text: And the instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build it and to plant [it];

title: Jeremiah 18:10
text: if it does evil in My sight, not to obey My voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would do them good.

title: Jeremiah 18:11
text: Now then please, speak to the men of Judah, and to the people of Jerusalem, saying, So says the LORD: Behold, I am forming evil against you, and devising a plan against you. Return now, each one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

title: Jeremiah 18:12
text: And they said, There is no hope; but we will walk after our own ways, and we will each one do [according to] the stubbornness of his evil heart.

title: Jeremiah 18:13
text: Therefore so says the LORD, Ask now among the nations; who has heard the like of this? The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

title: Jeremiah 18:14
text: Does the snow of Lebanon forsake the rock of the field? [Or] shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

title: Jeremiah 18:15
text: Because My people have forgotten Me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused themselves to stumble in their ways [from] the old paths, to walk [in] by-paths, not [in] the highway,

title: Jeremiah 18:16
text: to make their land desolate [and] a hissing forever. Everyone who passes by will be amazed, and will wag his head.

title: Jeremiah 18:17
text: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

title: Jeremiah 18:18
text: Then they said, Come and let us plot schemes against Jeremiah. For the law shall not perish from the priest, nor wisdom from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words.

title: Jeremiah 18:19
text: Pay attention to me; O LORD, and attend to the voice of my foes.

title: Jeremiah 18:20
text: Should evil be repaid for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before You to do good for them, [and] to turn away Your wrath from them.

title: Jeremiah 18:21
text: Therefore deliver up their sons to the famine, and give them over to the hand of the sword. And let their wives be bereaved, and widows, and their men [be] slain of death; let their young men be struck by the sword in battle.

title: Jeremiah 18:22
text: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when You suddenly bring a raiding party on them. For they have dug a pit to take me, and have hidden snares for my feet.

title: Jeremiah 18:23
text: Yet, LORD, You know all their counsel against me to kill [me]. Do not forgive their iniquity, nor blot out their sin from Your sight, but let them be overthrown before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.

title: Jeremiah 19:1
text: So says the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen jar, and [assemble] from the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests.

title: Jeremiah 19:2
text: And go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom by the entry of Potsherd Gate. And there declare the words that I shall tell you.

title: Jeremiah 19:3
text: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and people of Jerusalem. So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which shall cause the ears of him who hears it to tingle.

title: Jeremiah 19:4
text: Because they have forsaken Me, and have made this place [famous] and have burned incense in it to other gods whom they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents.

title: Jeremiah 19:5
text: They have also built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire [for] burnt offerings to Baal, which I never commanded nor spoke, nor did [it] come into My mind.

title: Jeremiah 19:6
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but, The Valley of Slaughter.

title: Jeremiah 19:7
text: And I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem come to nothing in this place, and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of those who seek their lives. And I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the animals of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 19:8
text: And I will make this city a waste and a hissing. Everyone who passes by shall be amazed and shall hiss because of all its plagues.

title: Jeremiah 19:9
text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall each one eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and distress, with which their enemies and those who seek their lives shall distress them.

title: Jeremiah 19:10
text: Then you shall break the jar before the eyes of the men who go with you,

title: Jeremiah 19:11
text: and shall say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, Even so I will break this people of this city, as [one] breaks a potter's vessel that cannot be made whole again. And they shall bury [them] in Tophet until there is no place [ left] to bury.

title: Jeremiah 19:12
text: I will do this to this place, says the LORD, and to its people, and make this city as Tophet.

title: Jeremiah 19:13
text: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be as defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the host of the heavens, and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.

title: Jeremiah 19:14
text: Then Jeremiah came from Tophet, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy. And he stood in the court of the LORD's house, and said to all the people,

title: Jeremiah 19:15
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have spoken against it, because they have hardened their necks so that they might not hear My words.

title: Jeremiah 20:1
text: When Pashur the son of Immer the priest (he was chief officer in the house of the LORD) heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

title: Jeremiah 20:2
text: then Pashur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that [were] in the upper Benjamin Gate, which [was] by the house of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 20:3
text: And it happened on the next day, Pashur brought Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, The LORD has not called your name Pashur, but Terror from All Around.

title: Jeremiah 20:4
text: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. And they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall behold [it]. And I will give all Judah into the king of Babylon's hand, and he will exile them into Babylon, and kill them with the sword.

title: Jeremiah 20:5
text: And I will give all the wealth of this city, and its produce, and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah, [even] I will give into the hand of their enemies; who will strip them and take them, and bring them to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 20:6
text: And you, Pashur, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity. And you shall come to Babylon, and you shall die there, and shall be buried there; you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.

title: Jeremiah 20:7
text: O LORD, You have deceived me, and I was deceived. You are stronger than I, and You have prevailed. I am in derision all the day; everyone laughs at me.

title: Jeremiah 20:8
text: For whenever I speak, I cry out, I cry violence and ruin; for the word of the LORD has been a reproach and a cause of mocking to me all day.

title: Jeremiah 20:9
text: Then I said, I will not mention Him, nor speak in His name any more. But [His word] was in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with holding in, and I could not stop.

title: Jeremiah 20:10
text: For I heard the slanders of many, Terror is all around! Expose! Yea, let us expose him! Every man of my peace is watching for my fall, [saying], Perhaps he will be lured away, and we shall prevail over him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

title: Jeremiah 20:11
text: But the LORD [is] with me like a mighty, awesome one. Therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not overcome me. They shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not be blessed. [Their] everlasting shame shall never be forgotten.

title: Jeremiah 20:12
text: But, O LORD of hosts, who tries the righteous [and] sees the reins and the heart, let me see Your vengeance on them. For I have committed my cause to You.

title: Jeremiah 20:13
text: Sing to the LORD, praise the LORD; for He has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

title: Jeremiah 20:14
text: Cursed [is] the day in which I was born; let not the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

title: Jeremiah 20:15
text: Cursed [is] the man who brought news to my father, saying, A man child is born to you; making him very glad.

title: Jeremiah 20:16
text: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not; and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

title: Jeremiah 20:17
text: because he did not kill me from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb [to be] always great [with me].

title: Jeremiah 20:18
