text: Why did I come forth from the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed in shame?

title: Jeremiah 21:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

title: Jeremiah 21:2
text: Please inquire of the LORD for us. For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is warring against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all His wonderful works, that he may go up from us.

title: Jeremiah 21:3
text: Then Jeremiah said to them, You shall say this to Zedekiah,

title: Jeremiah 21:4
text: So says the Jehovah, God of Israel: Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and [against] the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls. And I will gather them together in the middle of this city.

title: Jeremiah 21:5
text: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

title: Jeremiah 21:6
text: And I will strike the people of this city, both man and beast. They shall die of a great plague.

title: Jeremiah 21:7
text: And afterward, says the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and those who are left in this city from the plague, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. And he shall strike them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, nor have pity, nor have mercy.

title: Jeremiah 21:8
text: And to this people you shall say, So says the LORD, Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

title: Jeremiah 21:9
text: He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague. But he who goes out and falls to the Chaldeans who are all around you, he shall live, and his life shall be his prize.

title: Jeremiah 21:10
text: For I have set My face against this city for evil, and not for good, says the LORD. It shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

title: Jeremiah 21:11
text: And concerning the house of the king of Judah, [say], Hear the word of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 21:12
text: O house of David, so says the LORD: Do judgment in the morning, and deliver [him who is] robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest My fury go out like fire, and burn so that none can put [it] out, because of the evil of your doings.

title: Jeremiah 21:13
text: Behold, I [am] against you, O dweller of the valley, rock of the plain, says the LORD; those who say, Who shall come down against us? Or who shall enter into our homes?

title: Jeremiah 21:14
text: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says the LORD; and I will kindle a fire in the forest of it, and it shall devour all things around it.

title: Jeremiah 22:1
text: So says the LORD: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there.

title: Jeremiah 22:2
text: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you and your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

title: Jeremiah 22:3
text: So says the LORD, Do judgment and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the oppressors's hand. And do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, or the widow, nor shed innocent blood in this place.

title: Jeremiah 22:4
text: For if you do this thing indeed, then there shall enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

title: Jeremiah 22:5
text: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by Myself, says the LORD, that this house shall become a ruin.

title: Jeremiah 22:6
text: For so says the LORD to the king of Judah's house, You [are] Gilead to Me, [and] the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities with no people.

title: Jeremiah 22:7
text: And I will prepare destroyers against you, each one with his weapons. And they shall cut down your choice cedars, and throw [them] into the fire.

title: Jeremiah 22:8
text: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say each one to his neighbor, Why has the LORD done this to this great city?

title: Jeremiah 22:9
text: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshiped other gods, and served them.

title: Jeremiah 22:10
text: Weep not for the dead, nor moan for him; [but] weep bitterly for him who goes away. For he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

title: Jeremiah 22:11
text: For so says the LORD concerning Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, who reigned in the place of Josiah his father, who went forth out of this place; he shall not return there any more.

title: Jeremiah 22:12
text: But he shall die in the place where they have exiled him and shall see this land no more.

title: Jeremiah 22:13
text: Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness and his upper rooms without justice; his neighbor serves without pay, and he does not give him his work;

title: Jeremiah 22:14
text: who says, I will build myself a wide house and large rooms, and cuts out windows for himself, and puts in a cedar ceiling, and paints it with vermilion.

title: Jeremiah 22:15
text: Do you reign, because you lust to excel in cedar? Did not your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then [it was] well with him.

title: Jeremiah 22:16
text: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then [it was] well with him. Was this not to know Me? says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 22:17
text: But your eyes and your heart [are] for nothing but your unjust gain, and to shed innocent blood, and for cruelty, and to do violence.

title: Jeremiah 22:18
text: Therefore so says the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, They shall not mourn for him, [saying], Ah, my brother! or, Ah, sister! They shall not mourn for him, [saying], Ah, lord! or, Ah, his glory!

title: Jeremiah 22:19
text: He shall be buried [with] the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 22:20
text: Go up to Lebanon, and cry. And lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim, for all your lovers are destroyed.

title: Jeremiah 22:21
text: I spoke to you in your prosperity; [but] you said, I will not hear. This [has been] your way from your youth, for you have not obeyed My voice.

title: Jeremiah 22:22
text: The wind shall eat up all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity; surely then you will be ashamed and humiliated for all your wickedness.

title: Jeremiah 22:23
text: O dweller in Lebanon, nested in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs come to you, the pain as one giving birth?

title: Jeremiah 22:24
text: [As] I live, says the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on My right hand, yet I would pull you out of there!

title: Jeremiah 22:25
text: And I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand [of those] whose face you fear, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 22:26
text: And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into another country where you were not born. And there you shall die.

title: Jeremiah 22:27
text: But to the land to which they desire to return, there they shall not return.

title: Jeremiah 22:28
text: [Is] this man Coniah a despised broken jar? [Is he] a vessel in which there [is] no pleasure? Why are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they do not know?

title: Jeremiah 22:29
text: O earth, earth, earth! Hear the word of the LORD!

title: Jeremiah 22:30
text: So says the LORD, Write this man down as childless, a man who will not be blessed in his days. For no man of his seed shall be blessed, sitting on the throne of David and ruling any more in Judah.

title: Jeremiah 23:1
text: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:2
text: Therefore so says the LORD God of Israel against the shepherds who feed My people, You have scattered My flock, and have driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will bring on you the evil of your doings, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:3
text: And I will gather the remnant of My flock out of all countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their fold. And they shall be fruitful and multiply.

title: Jeremiah 23:4
text: And I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. And they shall fear no more, nor be afraid; nor shall they lack [anything], says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:5
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and act wisely, and shall do judgment and justice in the earth.

title: Jeremiah 23:6
text: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely. And this [is] His name by which He shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

title: Jeremiah 23:7
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD lives, who brought the sons of Israel up out of the land of Egypt;

title: Jeremiah 23:8
text: but, The LORD lives, who brought up and led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries where I have driven them. And they shall dwell in their own land.

title: Jeremiah 23:9
text: My heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of His holiness.

title: Jeremiah 23:10
text: For the land is full of adulterers. Yes, because of cursing the land mourns; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their power [is] not right.

title: Jeremiah 23:11
text: For both prophet and priest are ungodly; yes, in My house I have found their evil, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:12
text: So their way shall be to them as slippery [ways] in the darkness; they shall be driven on, and fall in them; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their judgment, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:13
text: And I have seen frivolity in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied by Baal and caused My people Israel to go astray.

title: Jeremiah 23:14
text: I have also seen in the prophets of Jerusalem a horrible thing; they commit adultery and walk in falsehood. They also strengthen to the hands of evildoers, so that none returns from his evil; they are all of them like Sodom to Me, and its inhabitants like Gomorrah.

title: Jeremiah 23:15
text: So the LORD of hosts says this concerning the prophets: Behold, I will feed them wormwood, and make them drink poisonous water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone forth into all the land.

title: Jeremiah 23:16
text: So says the LORD of hosts, Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They make you vain; they speak a vision from their own heart, not out of the mouth of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:17
text: They still say to those who despise Me, The LORD has said, You shall have peace! And they say to everyone who walks after the stubbornness of his own heart, No evil shall come on you!

title: Jeremiah 23:18
text: For who has stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hears His word? Who has listened to His word and heard [it]?

title: Jeremiah 23:19
text: Behold, the tempest of the LORD has gone forth in fury, a whirling tempest. It shall whirl on the head of the wicked.

title: Jeremiah 23:20
text: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until He has done and until He has set up the purposes of His heart; in later days you shall understand it perfectly.

title: Jeremiah 23:21
text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran; I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

title: Jeremiah 23:22
text: But if they had stood in My wisdom and had caused My people to hear My words, then they would have turned them from their evil way and from the evil of their doings.

title: Jeremiah 23:23
text: [Am] I a God near, says the LORD, and not a God afar off?

title: Jeremiah 23:24
text: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I shall not see him? says the LORD. Do I not fill the heavens and earth? says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:25
text: I have heard what the prophets said, who prophesy lies in My name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

title: Jeremiah 23:26
text: How long shall [this] be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies? But they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart,

title: Jeremiah 23:27
text: who plot to cause My people to forget My name by their dreams which they tell, each one to his neighbor, as their fathers have forgotten My name for Baal.

title: Jeremiah 23:28
text: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream. And he who has My word, let him speak My word faithfully. What [is] the chaff to the wheat? says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:29
text: [Is] not My word like a fire? says the LORD; and like a hammer [that] breaks the rock in pieces?

title: Jeremiah 23:30
text: So the LORD says, Behold, I [am] against the prophets who steal My words each one from his neighbor.

title: Jeremiah 23:31
text: The LORD says, Behold, I [am] against the prophets who use their tongues and say, He says.

title: Jeremiah 23:32
text: The LORD says, Behold, I [am] against those who prophesy false dreams and tell them, and cause My people to go astray by their lies and by their lightness. Yet I did not send them nor command them; therefore they shall not profit this people at all, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:33
text: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What [is] the burden of the LORD? You shall then say to them, What burden? I will even forsake you, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 23:34
text: And [as for] the prophet, and the priest, and the people, who shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.

title: Jeremiah 23:35
text: So you shall say each one to his neighbor, and each one to his brother, What has the LORD answered? And what has the LORD spoken?

title: Jeremiah 23:36
text: And you shall mention the burden of the LORD no more. For every man's word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.

title: Jeremiah 23:37
text: So you shall say to the prophet, What has the LORD answered you? And what has the LORD spoken?

title: Jeremiah 23:38
text: But since you say, The burden of the LORD; therefore so says the LORD, Because you say this word; the burden of the LORD; and I have sent to you saying, You shall not say, The burden of the LORD;

title: Jeremiah 23:39
text: therefore, behold, I, even I, will completely forget you, and I will forsake you and the city that I gave you and your fathers, [and cast you] out of My presence.

title: Jeremiah 23:40
text: And I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a never-ending shame, which shall not be forgotten.

title: Jeremiah 24:1
text: The LORD caused me to see, and behold, two baskets of figs set before the temple of the LORD (after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had exiled Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the rulers of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon);

title: Jeremiah 24:2
text: one basket [had] very good figs, like the first ripe figs. And the other basket [had] very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

title: Jeremiah 24:3
text: Then the LORD said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so that they cannot be eaten, they are so bad.

title: Jeremiah 24:4
text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 24:5
text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so I will acknowledge the exiles of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place [into] the land of the Chaldeans for [their] good.

title: Jeremiah 24:6
text: For I will set My eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. And I will build them and not pull [them] down; and I will plant them and not pluck them up.

title: Jeremiah 24:7
text: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I [am] the LORD; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God. For they shall return to Me with their whole heart.

title: Jeremiah 24:8
text: And like the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad; surely so says the LORD, So I will give to Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his rulers, and the rest of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt;

title: Jeremiah 24:9
text: and I will even make them a horror for evil to all the kingdoms of the earth, for a reproach and a proverb, a gibe and a curse, there in all places where I shall drive them.

title: Jeremiah 24:10
text: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the plague among them until they are destroyed from the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 25:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah. It [was] the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon;

title: Jeremiah 25:2
text: the word which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the people of Jerusalem, saying,

title: Jeremiah 25:3
text: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even to this day, that [is] the twenty-third year, the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking. But you have not listened.

title: Jeremiah 25:4
text: And the LORD has sent to you all His servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but you have not listened nor bowed down your ear to hear.

title: Jeremiah 25:5
text: They said, Turn again now, each one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and to your fathers forever and ever.

title: Jeremiah 25:6
text: And do not go after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no harm.

title: Jeremiah 25:7
text: Yet you have not listened to Me, says the LORD, so that you might provoke Me with the works of your hands, for harm to you.

title: Jeremiah 25:8
text: Therefore so says the LORD of hosts, Because you have not heard My words,

title: Jeremiah 25:9
text: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says the LORD, and Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant; and will bring them against this land, and against its people, and against all these nations all around. And I will completely destroy them, and make them a waste, and a hissing, and everlasting ruins.

title: Jeremiah 25:10
text: And I will take from them the voice of rejoicing and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the candle.

title: Jeremiah 25:11
text: And this whole land shall be a ruin [and] a waste. And these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

title: Jeremiah 25:12
text: And it shall be, when seventy years are fulfilled I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, and the land of the Chaldeans, says the LORD, for their iniquity, and I will make it an everlasting ruins.

title: Jeremiah 25:13
text: And I will bring on that land all My words which I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

title: Jeremiah 25:14
text: For many nations and great kings shall lay service on them also. And I will repay them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

title: Jeremiah 25:15
text: For so says the LORD, the God of Israel, to me, Take the wine cup of this wrath at My hand, and cause all the nations to whom I shall send you to drink it.

title: Jeremiah 25:16
text: And they shall drink, and reel to and fro, and be maddened, because of the sword that I will send among them.

title: Jeremiah 25:17
text: Then I took the cup at the LORD's hand, and made all the nations drink, to whom the LORD had sent me.

title: Jeremiah 25:18
text: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings of them, and their rulers, to make them a ruin and a, a hissing, and a curse, (as [it is] today),

title: Jeremiah 25:19
text: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and his servants, and his rulers, and all his people,

title: Jeremiah 25:20
text: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the rest of Ashdod;

title: Jeremiah 25:21
text: Edom, and Moab, and the sons of Ammon,

title: Jeremiah 25:22
text: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands beyond the sea,

title: Jeremiah 25:23
text: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and trim the edges [of their beards],

title: Jeremiah 25:24
text: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the desert,

title: Jeremiah 25:25
text: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

title: Jeremiah 25:26
text: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which [are] on the face of the earth; and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

title: Jeremiah 25:27
text: So you shall say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink and be drunk, and vomit, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

title: Jeremiah 25:28
text: And it shall be if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, So says the LORD of hosts, You shall certainly drink.

title: Jeremiah 25:29
text: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by My name; and should you be found entirely without guilt? You shall not be without guilt. For I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 25:30
text: And prophesy against them all these words, and say to them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter His voice from His holy habitation. He shall mightily roar over His dwelling place. He shall give a shout, like those who tread out [ grapes], against all the people of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 25:31
text: A noise shall come to the ends of the earth; for the LORD has a controversy with the nations; He will enter into judgment with all flesh. He will give those [who are] wicked to the sword, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 25:32
text: So says the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great tempest shall be stirred up from the corners of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 25:33
text: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from [one] end of the earth even to the [other] end of the earth; they shall not be mourned, nor gathered, nor buried. They shall be [as] dung on the ground.

title: Jeremiah 25:34
text: Howl, shepherds, and cry; and roll, leaders of the flock! For the days of your slaughter and of your scatterings are fulfilled; and you shall fall like a desirable vessel.

title: Jeremiah 25:35
text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the choice ones of the flock, to escape.

title: Jeremiah 25:36
text: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and a howling of the choice ones of the flock [shall be heard]; for the LORD has spoiled their pasture.

title: Jeremiah 25:37
text: And the peaceful pastures are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 25:38
text: Like the lion, He has left His den; for their land is wasted because of the oppressor's pressing fury, and because of His fierce anger.

title: Jeremiah 26:1
text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 26:2
text: So says the LORD: Stand in the court of the LORD's house and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD's house, all the words that I command you to speak to them; do not keep back a word.

title: Jeremiah 26:3
text: It may be that they will listen, and each man turn from his evil way, that I may repent of the evil which I plan to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

title: Jeremiah 26:4
text: And you shall say to them, So says the LORD: If you will not listen to Me, to walk in My law which I have set before you,

title: Jeremiah 26:5
text: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets whom I am sending to you (both rising up early and sending them, but you have not listened);

title: Jeremiah 26:6
text: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 26:7
text: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 26:8
text: And it happened when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded [him] to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, You shall surely die!

title: Jeremiah 26:9
text: Why have you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be wasted, without inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 26:10
text: When the rulers of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house to the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD's [house].

title: Jeremiah 26:11
text: And the priests and the prophets spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, [Let] a death sentence be for this man, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

title: Jeremiah 26:12
text: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the rulers and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

title: Jeremiah 26:13
text: So now make your ways and your doings good, and obey the voice of the LORD your God. And the LORD will repent of the evil that He has spoken against you.

title: Jeremiah 26:14
text: As for me, behold, I [am] in your hand. Do with me as seems good and right to you.

title: Jeremiah 26:15
text: But know for certain that if you put me to death you shall surely bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city, and on its people. For truly the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.

title: Jeremiah 26:16
text: Then the rulers and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, There [is] not a sentence of death for this man; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

title: Jeremiah 26:17
text: Then some of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

title: Jeremiah 26:18
text: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, So says the LORD of hosts: Zion shall be plowed [like] a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house like the high places of a forest.

title: Jeremiah 26:19
text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah indeed put him to death? Did he not fear the LORD, and pray to the LORD, and the LORD repented of the evil which He had spoken against them? So we are doing great evil against our souls.

title: Jeremiah 26:20
text: And there was also a man who prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 26:21
text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the rulers, heard his words, the king tried to put him to death. But when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled and went into Egypt.

title: Jeremiah 26:22
text: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt; Elnathan the son of Achbor, and men with him into Egypt.

title: Jeremiah 26:23
text: And they brought Urijah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and threw his dead body into the graves of the common people.

title: Jeremiah 26:24
text: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

title: Jeremiah 27:1
text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 27:2
text: So says the LORD to me, Make bonds and yokes for yourself, and put them on your neck.

title: Jeremiah 27:3
text: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who came to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 27:4
text: And command them to [go to] their masters, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: So you shall say to your masters,

title: Jeremiah 27:5
text: I have made the earth, the man, and the animals on the face of the earth, by My great power and by My outstretched arm, and have given it to whom it seemed right to Me.

title: Jeremiah 27:6
text: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant. And I have also given him the beast of the field to serve him.

title: Jeremiah 27:7
text: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes. And then many nations and great kings shall enslave him.

title: Jeremiah 27:8
text: And it shall be, the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation I will punish, says the LORD, with the sword and with the famine, and with the plague, until I have destroyed them by his hand.

title: Jeremiah 27:9
text: As for you, do not listen to your prophets, nor to your fortune tellers, nor to your dreams, nor to your conjurers, nor to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 27:10
text: For they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, and that I should drive you out and you should perish.

title: Jeremiah 27:11
text: But the nations who bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those I will leave it on their own land, says the LORD. And [they] shall work it and dwell in it.

title: Jeremiah 27:12
text: I also spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

title: Jeremiah 27:13
text: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague, as the LORD has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

title: Jeremiah 27:14
text: Therefore do not listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon. For they prophesy a lie to you.

title: Jeremiah 27:15
text: For I have not sent them, says the LORD; yet they prophesy a lie in My name, so that I might drive you out, and that you might perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you.

title: Jeremiah 27:16
text: Also I spoke to the priests and to all the people, saying, So says the LORD, Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon. For they prophesy a lie to you.

title: Jeremiah 27:17
text: Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon and live. For why should this city be laid waste?

title: Jeremiah 27:18
text: But if they [are] prophets, and if the word of the LORD is with them, let them now pray to the LORD of hosts that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and [in] the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, may not go to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 27:19
text: For so says the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels which remain in this city,

title: Jeremiah 27:20
text: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he exiled Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

title: Jeremiah 27:21
text: yes, so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain [in] the house of the LORD and [in] the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem:

title: Jeremiah 27:22
text: They shall be carried to Babylon, and they shall be there until the day that I visit them, says the LORD. Then I will bring them up and give them back to this place.

title: Jeremiah 28:1
text: And it happened in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

title: Jeremiah 28:2
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 28:3
text: Within two full years I will again bring into this place all the vessels of the LORD's house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried them to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 28:4
text: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah who went into Babylon, says the LORD. For I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 28:5
text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence all the people who stood in the house of the LORD,

title: Jeremiah 28:6
text: even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen. May the LORD do [so]. May the LORD confirm your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD's house, and all that is exiled from Babylon into this place.

title: Jeremiah 28:7
text: But hear now this word that I speak in your ears and in the ears of all the people:

title: Jeremiah 28:8
text: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of plague.

title: Jeremiah 28:9
text: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, [then] the prophet shall be known, that the LORD has truly sent him.

title: Jeremiah 28:10
text: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck and broke it.

title: Jeremiah 28:11
text: And Hananiah spoke for the eyes of all the people, saying, So says the LORD, Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the time of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

title: Jeremiah 28:12
text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 28:13
text: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, So says the LORD: You have broken the yokes of wood, but you shall make for them yokes of iron.

title: Jeremiah 28:14
text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And they shall serve him. And I have given him the beasts of the field also.

title: Jeremiah 28:15
text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah. The LORD has not sent you, but you make this people to trust in a lie.

title: Jeremiah 28:16
text: Therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will drive you from off the face of the earth. You shall die this year, because you have taught rebellion against the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 28:17
text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

title: Jeremiah 29:1
text: And these [are] the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders of the exile, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 29:2
text: (After Jeconiah the king, and the queen mother, and the eunuchs, the rulers of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, had departed from Jerusalem.)

title: Jeremiah 29:3
text: The letter came by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah the king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying,

title: Jeremiah 29:4
text: So says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, to all the exiles whom I caused to be exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon:

title: Jeremiah 29:5
text: Build houses and live [in them]; and plant gardens and eat their fruit.

title: Jeremiah 29:6
text: Take wives and father sons and daughters. And take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, so that they may bear sons and daughters, that you may be multiplied there and not become few.

title: Jeremiah 29:7
text: And seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be exiled, and pray to the LORD for it. For in its peace you shall have peace.

title: Jeremiah 29:8
text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Do not let your prophets and your fortune-tellers in your midst deceive you, nor listen to your dreams which you dream.

title: Jeremiah 29:9
text: For they prophesy falsely to you in My name; I have not sent them, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 29:10
text: For so says the LORD, When according to My word seventy years have been fulfilled for Babylon, I will visit you and confirm My good word to you, to bring you back to this place.

title: Jeremiah 29:11
text: For I know the purposes which I am purposing for you, says the LORD; purposes of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.

title: Jeremiah 29:12
text: Then you shall call on Me, and you shall go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.

title: Jeremiah 29:13
text: And you shall seek Me and find [Me], when you search for Me with all your heart.

title: Jeremiah 29:14
text: And I will be found by you, says the LORD; and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you, says the LORD. And I will bring you again into the place from where I caused you to be exiled.

title: Jeremiah 29:15
text: Because you have said, The LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon;

title: Jeremiah 29:16
text: so says the LORD of the king who sits on the throne of David, and of all the people who dwell in this city, [and] of your brothers who have not gone out with you into captivity;

title: Jeremiah 29:17
text: so says the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the plague, and will make them like worthless figs which cannot be eaten from badness.

title: Jeremiah 29:18
text: And I will pursue them with the sword, with the famine, and with the plague, and will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and a waste, and a hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations where I have driven them,

title: Jeremiah 29:19
text: because they have not listened to My words, says the LORD, which I sent to them by My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending; but you would not hear, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 29:20
text: And hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon;

title: Jeremiah 29:21
text: so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, about Ahab the son of Kolaiah and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in My name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall kill them before your eyes.

title: Jeremiah 29:22
text: And a curse shall be taken up from them by all the exiles of Judah who [are] in Babylon, saying, May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,

title: Jeremiah 29:23
text: because they have committed evil in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives, and have spoken lying words in My name, which I have not commanded them; for I [am] He who knows and a witness, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 29:24
text: You shall also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

title: Jeremiah 29:25
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because you have sent letters in your name to all the people who [are] at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

title: Jeremiah 29:26
text: The LORD has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, to be officers [in] the house of the LORD, over every madman who prophesies, that you should put him into the stocks and into the collar.

title: Jeremiah 29:27
text: Now therefore why have you not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, who prophesies to you?

title: Jeremiah 29:28
text: For this cause he sent to us [in] Babylon, saying, This [exile is] long. Build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their fruit.

title: Jeremiah 29:29
text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

title: Jeremiah 29:30
text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 29:31
text: Send to all the exiles, saying, So says the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I did not send him, and he caused you to trust in a lie,

title: Jeremiah 29:32
text: therefore so says the LORD, Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his seed. He shall not have a man to dwell among this people; nor shall he behold the good which I shall do for My people, says the LORD, because he has taught rebellion against the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 30:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 30:2
text: So speaks the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

title: Jeremiah 30:3
text: For, lo, the days come, says the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of My people Israel and Judah, says the LORD. And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave their fathers, and they shall possess it.

title: Jeremiah 30:4
text: And these [are] the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

title: Jeremiah 30:5
text: For so says the LORD, We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

title: Jeremiah 30:6
text: Ask now, and see whether a man is giving birth? Why do I see every man with his hands on his loins, like a woman in labor, and all faces are turned into paleness?

title: Jeremiah 30:7
text: Alas! For that day [is] great, so that none [is] like it; it [is] even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

title: Jeremiah 30:8
text: For it shall be in that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will break his yoke from your neck and will burst your bonds. And strangers shall no longer enslave him,

title: Jeremiah 30:9
text: but they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

title: Jeremiah 30:10
text: And you, O My servant Jacob, do not fear, says the LORD. Do not be terrified, O Israel. For lo, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity. And Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make [him] afraid.

title: Jeremiah 30:11
text: For I [am] with you, says the LORD, to save you. Though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered you, yet I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will not leave you entirely unpunished.

title: Jeremiah 30:12
text: For so says the LORD, Your break cannot be cured, and your wound [is] grievous.

title: Jeremiah 30:13
text: [There is] none to plead your cause; for [your] ulcer there are [no] healing medicines for you.

title: Jeremiah 30:14
text: All your lovers have forgotten you; they do not seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity; [because] your sins are many.

title: Jeremiah 30:15
text: Why do you cry over your crushing? Your pain [is] incurable, for the greatness of your iniquity; because your sins are many, I have done these things to you.

title: Jeremiah 30:16
text: So all those who devour you shall be devoured; and all your enemies, every one of them, shall go into captivity. And they who rob you shall be robbed, and all who strip you I will strip.

title: Jeremiah 30:17
text: For I will give health back to you, and will heal you of your wounds, says the LORD; because they called you an outcast, [saying], This is Zion; no one is seeking for her.

title: Jeremiah 30:18
text: So says the LORD: Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and will have mercy on his dwelling places. And the city shall be built on her own hill, and the palace shall remain in its own place.

title: Jeremiah 30:19
text: And out of them shall come thanksgiving, and the voice of those who rejoice. And I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

title: Jeremiah 30:20
text: Also their sons shall be as they were before, and their congregation shall be established before Me, and I will punish all who ill-treat them.

title: Jeremiah 30:21
text: And their rulers shall be of themselves, and their governor shall come from among them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach Me. For who [is] this who pledged his heart to come near to Me? says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 30:22
text: And you shall be My people, and I will be your God.

title: Jeremiah 30:23
text: Behold, the tempest of the LORD goes forth with fury, a never-ending tempest; it shall fall with pain on the head of the wicked.

title: Jeremiah 30:24
text: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return until He has done [it], and until He has fulfilled the intentions of His heart. In the latter days you shall understand it.

title: Jeremiah 31:1
text: At that time, says the LORD, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people.

title: Jeremiah 31:2
text: So says the LORD, The people [who were] left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I will go to give him rest.

title: Jeremiah 31:3
text: The LORD has appeared to me from afar, [saying], Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with loving-kindness I have drawn you.

title: Jeremiah 31:4
text: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel. You shall again put on your tambourines, and shall go forth in the dances of those who rejoice.

title: Jeremiah 31:5
text: You shall yet plant vines on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall eat [them] as common things.

title: Jeremiah 31:6
text: For there shall be a day [that] the watchmen on Mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise and let us go up to Zion to the LORD our God!

title: Jeremiah 31:7
text: For so says the LORD, Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations. Cry out, give praise and say, O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 31:8
text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country and gather them from the corners of the earth, and with [them] the blind and the lame, the woman with child and she who is in labor with child, together; a great company shall return there.

title: Jeremiah 31:9
text: They shall come with weeping, and with prayers I will lead them. I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way; they shall not stumble in it, for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim [is] My firstborn.

title: Jeremiah 31:10
text: Hear the word of the LORD, O nations, and declare [it] in the coastlands afar off. And say, He who scattered Israel will gather him and keep him, as a shepherd [keeps] his flock.

title: Jeremiah 31:11
text: For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of the one stronger than he.

title: Jeremiah 31:12
text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the sons of the flock and the herd. And their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not pine away any more at all.

title: Jeremiah 31:13
text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them and make them rejoice from their affliction.

title: Jeremiah 31:14
text: And I will fill the soul of the priests with fatness, and My people shall be satisfied with My goodness, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 31:15
text: So says the LORD: A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing [and] bitter weeping; Rachel weeping for her sons; she refuses to be comforted for her sons, because they [are] not.

title: Jeremiah 31:16
text: So says the LORD: Hold back your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears; for your work shall be rewarded, says the LORD. And they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

title: Jeremiah 31:17
text: And there is hope for your future, says the LORD, that [your] sons shall come again to their own border.

title: Jeremiah 31:18
text: I have surely heard Ephraim mourning to himself, [saying], You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bull not broken in; turn me, and I shall be turned. For You [are] the LORD my God.

title: Jeremiah 31:19
text: Surely after I was turned, I repented; and after I was taught, I struck on [my] thigh. I was ashamed, yea, I even blushed, because I bore the disgrace of my youth.

title: Jeremiah 31:20
text: [Is] Ephraim My dear son? [Is he] a delightful child? For as often as I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still. Therefore My bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 31:21
text: Set up waymarks, make sign posts for yourself. Set your heart toward the highway, the way you went. Turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these your cities.

title: Jeremiah 31:22
text: How long will you turn to and fro, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land; a woman shall enclose a man.

title: Jeremiah 31:23
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Again they shall speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I shall again bring their captivity: The LORD bless you, O home of justice [and] mountain of holiness.

title: Jeremiah 31:24
text: And farmers, and those going forth with flocks, shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities of it together.

title: Jeremiah 31:25
text: For I satisfy the weary soul, and I fill every sorrowful soul.

title: Jeremiah 31:26
text: On this I awoke and looked up; and my sleep was sweet to me.

title: Jeremiah 31:27
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.

title: Jeremiah 31:28
text: And it shall be, as I have watched over them to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so I will watch over them to build, and to plant, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 31:29
text: In those days they shall not say any more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the sons are dull.

title: Jeremiah 31:30
text: But every man shall die in his iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be dull.

title: Jeremiah 31:31
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will cut a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

title: Jeremiah 31:32
text: not according to the covenant that I cut with their fathers in the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which covenant of Mine they broke, although I was a husband to them, says the LORD;

title: Jeremiah 31:33
text: but this [shall be] the covenant that I will cut with the house of Israel: After those days, says the LORD, I will put My law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

title: Jeremiah 31:34
text: And they shall no more teach each man his neighbor and each man his brother, saying, Know the LORD; for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, says the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sins no more.

title: Jeremiah 31:35
text: So says the LORD, who gives the sun for a light by day and the laws of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who divides the sea when its waves roar; the LORD of hosts [is] His name;

title: Jeremiah 31:36
text: if those ordinances depart from Me, says the LORD, the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before Me forever.

title: Jeremiah 31:37
text: So says the LORD, If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below can be searched out, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 31:38
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the Tower of Hananeel to the Corner Gate.

title: Jeremiah 31:39
text: And the measuring line shall yet go before it to the hill Gareb, and shall go around to Goath.

title: Jeremiah 31:40
text: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook of Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, [shall be] holy to the LORD. It shall not be plucked up nor thrown down any more forever.

title: Jeremiah 32:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which [was] the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

title: Jeremiah 32:2
text: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem. And Jeremiah the prophet was shut in the court of the guard, which [was] in the king of Judah's house.

title: Jeremiah 32:3
text: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Why do you prophesy and say, So says the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it,

title: Jeremiah 32:4
text: and Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes,

title: Jeremiah 32:5
text: and he shall lead Zedekiah into Babylon, and there he shall be until I visit him, says the LORD; though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not be blessed?

title: Jeremiah 32:6
text: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 32:7
text: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum your uncle shall come to you, saying, Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth; for the right to redeem it [is] yours, to buy [it].

title: Jeremiah 32:8
text: So Hanameel my uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD and said to me, Please buy my field in Anathoth, which [is] in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance [is] yours, and the right to redeem [is] yours. Buy [it] for yourself. Then I knew that this [was] the word of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 32:9
text: And I bought the field in Anathoth, of Hanameel my uncle's son, and weighed him the silver, seventeen shekels of silver.

title: Jeremiah 32:10
text: And I wrote it in the document, and sealed [it], and called witnesses, and weighed the silver in the scales.

title: Jeremiah 32:11
text: So I took the document of the purchase, that which was sealed [according] to the law and custom, and the open copy.

title: Jeremiah 32:12
text: And I gave the document of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, before the eyes of Hanameel my uncle's [son], and before the eyes of the witnesses who wrote in the purchase document, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

title: Jeremiah 32:13
text: And I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

title: Jeremiah 32:14
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Take these books, the purchase document, the one sealed and the open book, and put them in an earthen vessel so that they may stand many days.

title: Jeremiah 32:15
text: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards shall be owned again in this land.

title: Jeremiah 32:16
text: And after I gave the purchase document to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 32:17
text: Ah, Lord Jehovah! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and stretched out arm. Nothing is too great for You.

title: Jeremiah 32:18
text: You show loving-kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their sons after them. The great, the mighty God, the LORD of hosts, [is] His name,

title: Jeremiah 32:19
text: great in wisdom and mighty in work; for Your eyes [are] open on all the ways of the sons of men, to give every one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his doings.

title: Jeremiah 32:20
text: For You have set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, until this day, and in Israel, and among men; and have made You a name, as at this day;

title: Jeremiah 32:21
text: and have brought forth Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror.

title: Jeremiah 32:22
text: And You have given them this land, which You swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

title: Jeremiah 32:23
text: And they came in and possessed it, but they did not obey Your voice, nor did they walk in Your law. They have done nothing of all that You commanded them to do; therefore You have caused all this evil to come on them.

title: Jeremiah 32:24
text: Behold, the siege mounds have come to the city to take it; and the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the plague. And what You have spoken has happened; and, behold, You saw [it].

title: Jeremiah 32:25
text: And You have said to me, O Lord Jehovah, Buy the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 32:26
text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 32:27
text: Behold, I [am] the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for Me?

title: Jeremiah 32:28
text: Therefore so says the LORD: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it.

title: Jeremiah 32:29
text: And the Chaldeans who fight against this city shall come up and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke Me to anger.

title: Jeremiah 32:30
text: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have only done evil before Me from their youth. For the sons of Israel have only provoked Me to anger with the work of their hands, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 32:31
text: For this city has been to Me as a cause of My anger and of My fury from the day that they built it even to this day; that I should remove it from before My face

title: Jeremiah 32:32
text: because of all the evil of the sons of Israel and of the sons of Judah, which they have done to provoke Me to anger, they, their kings, their rulers, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 32:33
text: And they have turned the back to Me, and not the face; though I taught them, rising up early and teaching [them], yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

title: Jeremiah 32:34
text: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.

title: Jeremiah 32:35
text: And they built the high places of Baal, in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire to Molech; which I did not command them, nor did it come into My mind that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

title: Jeremiah 32:36
text: And now therefore, so says the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city of which you say, It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague:

title: Jeremiah 32:37
text: Behold, I will gather them out of all the lands where I have driven them in My anger, and in My fury, and in great wrath. And I will bring them again to this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely.

title: Jeremiah 32:38
text: And they shall be My people, and I will be their God.

title: Jeremiah 32:39
text: And I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear Me forever, for their good and for the good of their sons after them.

title: Jeremiah 32:40
text: And I will cut an everlasting covenant with them that I will not turn away from them, to do them good. But I will put My fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from Me.

title: Jeremiah 32:41
text: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will truly plant them in this land with all My heart and all My whole soul.

title: Jeremiah 32:42
text: For so says the LORD: As I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

title: Jeremiah 32:43
text: And fields shall be bought in this land of which you say, [It is] a desert without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 32:44
text: Men shall buy fields for silver, and write it in a book, and seal [it], and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south. For I will cause their captivity to return, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 33:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

title: Jeremiah 33:2
text: So says the LORD the Maker of it, the LORD who formed it in order to establish it; the LORD [is] His name:

title: Jeremiah 33:3
text: Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and inscrutable things which you do not know.

title: Jeremiah 33:4
text: For so says the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down [to defend] against the siege-mounds and against the sword:

title: Jeremiah 33:5
text: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men whom I have slain in My anger and in My fury, and for all whose evil I have hidden My face from this city.

title: Jeremiah 33:6
text: Behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will heal them and will show them the riches of peace and truth.

title: Jeremiah 33:7
text: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

title: Jeremiah 33:8
text: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against Me; and I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned, and by which they have transgressed against Me.

title: Jeremiah 33:9
text: And it shall be to Me a name of joy, a praise and an honor before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do to them. And they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the riches that I bring to it.

title: Jeremiah 33:10
text: So says the LORD: Again there shall be heard in this place, which you say [is] a waste without man and without beast, [even] in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast;

title: Jeremiah 33:11
text: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts, for the LORD [is] good, for His mercy [endures] forever; and the voice of those who shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause the captivity of the land to return, as at the first, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 33:12
text: So says the LORD of hosts: Again in this place which is a desert without man and without beast, and in all its cities, there [shall be] a home of shepherds causing [their] flocks to lie down.

title: Jeremiah 33:13
text: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him who tallies, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 33:14
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will establish the good thing which I have spoken to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 33:15
text: In those days, and at that time, I will cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. And He shall do judgment and righteousness in the land.

title: Jeremiah 33:16
text: In those days Judah shall be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely. And this [is the name] with which she shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

title: Jeremiah 33:17
text: For so says the LORD, David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,

title: Jeremiah 33:18
text: nor shall the priests the Levites lack a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle grain offerings, and to do sacrifice forever.

title: Jeremiah 33:19
text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 33:20
text: So says the LORD: If you can break My covenant of the day and My covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season,

title: Jeremiah 33:21
text: [then] also may My covenant with David My servant be broken, that he should not have a son to reign on his throne, and [My covenant] with the Levites the priests, My ministers.

title: Jeremiah 33:22
text: As the host of the heavens cannot be numbered, nor the sand of the sea measured, so I will multiply the seed of David My servant and the Levites who minister to Me.

title: Jeremiah 33:23
text: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 33:24
text: Do you not consider what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD has chosen, He has even cast them off? So they have despised My people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

title: Jeremiah 33:25
text: So says the LORD: If My covenant [is] not with day and night, [and if] I have not given the ordinances of the heavens and the earth,

title: Jeremiah 33:26
text: then I will cast away the seed of Jacob, and David My servant, [so] that I will not take [any] of his seed [to be] rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will bring back their captivity, and have mercy on them.

title: Jeremiah 34:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth (because his hand rules) and all the peoples, fought against Jerusalem and against all its cities; saying,

title: Jeremiah 34:2
text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, So says the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

title: Jeremiah 34:3
text: And you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be captured and delivered into his hand. And your eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 34:4
text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah: So says the LORD of you, You shall not die by the sword.

title: Jeremiah 34:5
text: You shall die in peace; and as the burnings of spices [for] your fathers, the former kings which were before you, so they shall burn [spices] for you. And they will mourn you, saying, Ah, lord! For I have spoken the word, says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 34:6
text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

title: Jeremiah 34:7
text: when the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem and against all the remaining cities of Judah; against Lachish, and against Azekah; for these fortified cities remained of the cities of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 34:8
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after king Zedekiah had cut a covenant with all the people at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,

title: Jeremiah 34:9
text: that each man should let his male slave, and each man his female slave, [if] a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, to go free, that none should enslave a Jew, his brother among them.

title: Jeremiah 34:10
text: And all the rulers obeyed, and all the people who had entered into the covenant allowed them to go free, each man his male slave, and each man his female slave, so that not any should enslave among them any more; and they obeyed and let [ them] go.

title: Jeremiah 34:11
text: But afterward they turned and caused the slaves and slave women whom they had let go free, to return! And they subjected them for slaves and slave women.

title: Jeremiah 34:12
text: So the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 34:13
text: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: I cut a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out from the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying,

title: Jeremiah 34:14
text: At the end of seven years each man should let go his brother, a Hebrew, and who has been sold to him. And when he has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you. But your fathers did not listen to me, nor bow down their ears.

title: Jeremiah 34:15
text: And you had turned today, and had done right in My sight to call for liberty, each man to his neighbor. And you had cut a covenant before Me in the house which is called by My name.

title: Jeremiah 34:16
text: But you turned and defiled My name, and each man caused his slave, and each man caused his slave woman, whom you had set free to do as they pleased, to return. And you brought them into service to be slaves and slave women to you.

title: Jeremiah 34:17
text: So the LORD says this: You have not listened to Me to proclaim liberty each man to his brother, and each man to his neighbor! Behold, I call for freedom for you, says the LORD, to the sword, to the plague, and to the famine. And I will cause you to be a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 34:18
text: And I will give the men who have sinned against My covenant, who have not done the words of the covenant which they cut before Me [when they] cut the calf in two and passed between its parts;

title: Jeremiah 34:19
text: the rulers of Judah, and the rulers of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf;

title: Jeremiah 34:20
text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. And their dead bodies shall be for food to the birds of the heavens and to the beasts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 34:21
text: And I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, and his rulers, into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, who have withdrawn from you.

title: Jeremiah 34:22
text: Behold, I will command, says the LORD, and cause them to return to this city. And they shall fight against it and capture it, and burn it with fire. And I will make the cities of Judah a desert without a soul to live in it.

title: Jeremiah 35:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the sons of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 35:2
text: Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the rooms. And give them wine to drink.

title: Jeremiah 35:3
text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.

title: Jeremiah 35:4
text: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which [was] near the room of the rulers, above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door.

title: Jeremiah 35:5
text: And I set pots full of wine, and cups, before the sons of the house of the Rechabites. And I said to them, Drink wine!

title: Jeremiah 35:6
text: But they said, We will drink no wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, [you] nor your sons forever.

title: Jeremiah 35:7
text: Nor shall you build houses, nor sow seed, nor plant a vineyard, nor have [anything]; but all your days you shall live in tents, so that you may live many days in the land where you are strangers.

title: Jeremiah 35:8
text: So we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he has commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

title: Jeremiah 35:9
text: nor to build houses for us to live in. Nor do we have vineyard, nor field, nor seed.

title: Jeremiah 35:10
text: But we have lived in tents, and have obeyed and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

title: Jeremiah 35:11
text: But it happened when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, Come and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the Chaldean army, and for fear of the Syrian army. So we are living at Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 35:12
text: Then came the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 35:13
text: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and tell the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to listen to My words? says the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 35:14
text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, which he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are done. For to this day they do not drink, but obey their father's commandment. But I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you did not listen to Me.

title: Jeremiah 35:15
text: I have also sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending, saying, Return now each man from his evil way, and make your doings good, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers. But you have not bowed down your ear, nor listened to Me.

title: Jeremiah 35:16
text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have done the commandment of their father, which He commanded them; but this people has not listened to Me;

title: Jeremiah 35:17
text: therefore so says the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem all the evil that I have spoken against them. Because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

title: Jeremiah 35:18
text: And Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father, and have kept all his precepts, and have done according to all that he has commanded you;

title: Jeremiah 35:19
text: therefore so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not lack a man to stand before Me forever.

title: Jeremiah 36:1
text: And it happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

title: Jeremiah 36:2
text: Take for yourself a roll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day.

title: Jeremiah 36:3
text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I plan to do to them, that they may each man turn from his evil way, so that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

title: Jeremiah 36:4
text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah. And Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which He had spoken to him, on a roll of a book.

title: Jeremiah 36:5
text: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I [am] shut up. I cannot go into the house of the LORD.

title: Jeremiah 36:6
text: Therefore you go, and read in the roll which you have written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the [in] the LORD's house on the fasting day. And also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

title: Jeremiah 36:7
text: It may be they will present their prayer before the LORD, and will return, each one from his evil way. For great [is] the anger and the fury that the LORD has spoken against this people.

title: Jeremiah 36:8
text: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book, the words of the LORD in the LORD's house.

title: Jeremiah 36:9
text: And it happened in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, they called a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 36:10
text: And Baruch read in the book, the words of Jeremiah [in] the house of the LORD, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entrance to the New Gate of the LORD's house, in the ears of all the people.

title: Jeremiah 36:11
text: When Michaiah, the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD out of the book,

title: Jeremiah 36:12
text: then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's room. And, lo, all the rulers sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the rulers.

title: Jeremiah 36:13
text: Then Michaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

title: Jeremiah 36:14
text: Therefore all the rulers sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, Take the roll in your hand in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand and came to them.

title: Jeremiah 36:15
