text: And you shall say, In this way shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring on her. And they shall be weary. So far [are] the words of Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:1
text: Zedekiah [was] twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

title: Jeremiah 52:2
text: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

title: Jeremiah 52:3
text: For it was because of the anger of the LORD in Jerusalem and Judah (until He had cast them out from His presence) that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:4
text: And it happened in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth [day] of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it and built forts against it all around.

title: Jeremiah 52:5
text: So the city was under attack until the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:6
text: And in the fourth month, in the ninth of the month, the famine was very grievous in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

title: Jeremiah 52:7
text: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which [was] by the king's garden. (And the Chaldeans [were] beside the city all around.) And they went by the way of the plain.

title: Jeremiah 52:8
text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. And all his army was scattered from him.

title: Jeremiah 52:9
text: And they took the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon, to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgments against him.

title: Jeremiah 52:10
text: And the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the rulers of Judah in Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:11
text: And he blinded the eyes of Zedekiah. And the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

title: Jeremiah 52:12
text: And in the fifth month, in the tenth of the month, which [was] the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebu-zaradan, chief of the executioners, [who] served the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 52:13
text: And he burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house. And he burned with fire all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great ones.

title: Jeremiah 52:14
text: And all the army of the Chaldeans with the chief of the executioners broke down all Jerusalem's walls all around.

title: Jeremiah 52:15
text: And Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners exiled [some] of the poor of the people, and the rest of the people who remained in the city, and those who fell away, who fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

title: Jeremiah 52:16
text: But Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners left [some] of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for farmers.

title: Jeremiah 52:17
text: Also the Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that [were] in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the bronze sea in the house of the LORD, and carried all the bronze of them to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:18
text: They also took away the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they served.

title: Jeremiah 52:19
text: And the chief of the executioners took away the basins, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the pots, and the lampstands, and the spoons, and the cups; what [was] gold, [in] gold; and what [was] silver, [in] silver.

title: Jeremiah 52:20
text: the two pillars, one sea, and twelve bronze bulls that [were] under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD; the bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

title: Jeremiah 52:21
text: And the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits. And a line of twelve cubits went around it, and the thickness of it [was] four fingers. [It was] hollow.

title: Jeremiah 52:22
text: And a capital of bronze [was] on it. And the height of one capital [was] five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capitals all around, all [of] bronze. The second pillar also, and the pomegranates, [were] like these.

title: Jeremiah 52:23
text: And there were ninety-six pomegranates on a side; all the pomegranates on the network [were] a hundred all around.

title: Jeremiah 52:24
text: And the chief of the executioners took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.

title: Jeremiah 52:25
text: He also took out of the city a eunuch who was in charge of the men of war; and seven men from those who were near the king's person, who were found in the city; and the chief scribe of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

title: Jeremiah 52:26
text: And Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners took them and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:27
text: And the king of Babylon struck them and slaughtered them in Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was exiled out of his own land.

title: Jeremiah 52:28
text: This [is] the people whom Nebuchadnezzar exiled: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews;

title: Jeremiah 52:29
text: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he exiled from Jerusalem eight hundred and thirty-two persons;

title: Jeremiah 52:30
text: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebu-zaradan the chief of the executioners exiled seven hundred and forty-five persons of the Jews. All the persons [were] four thousand and six hundred.

title: Jeremiah 52:31
text: And it happened in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth of the month, Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the [first] year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him out from prison,

title: Jeremiah 52:32
text: and spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who [were] with him in Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:33
text: And he changed his prison garments, and he ate bread before him all the days of his life.

title: Jeremiah 52:34
text: And his allowance in continual allowance was given him from the king of Babylon, the matter of a day in its day, until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

title: Lamentations 1:1
text: How alone sits the city [that was] full of people! She has become like a widow, [once] great among the nations, a noblewoman among the nations, [but now] has become a tribute-payer.

title: Lamentations 1:2
text: She bitterly weeps in the night, and her tears [are] on her cheeks; among all her lovers, she has none to comfort her. All her friends have dealt deceitfully with her; they became her enemies.

title: Lamentations 1:3
text: Judah went into captivity because of affliction, and from great slavery. She dwells among the nations; she finds no rest; all her pursuers have overtaken her between the narrows.

title: Lamentations 1:4
text: The roads of Zion mourn without [any] going to the appointed feasts. All her gates are deserted; her priests sigh; her virgins are afflicted, and she [is] in bitterness.

title: Lamentations 1:5
text: Her enemies have become as chief; her haters are at ease; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her sins. Her children have gone, captive before the enemy.

title: Lamentations 1:6
text: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty has departed. Her rulers have become like bucks: they find no pasture, and they have gone without strength before the pursuer.

title: Lamentations 1:7
text: [In the] days of her affliction and her wandering Jerusalem remembered all her desirable things from previous days; when her people fell into the hand of the foe; and there is no ally for her. The foes saw her; they laughed at her annihilation.

title: Lamentations 1:8
text: Jerusalem has grievously sinned, therefore she has been removed. All knowing her despise her because they saw her nakedness; yea, she sighs and turns backward.

title: Lamentations 1:9
text: Her uncleanness [is] in her skirts; she did not remember her end, and has gone down astoundingly. There is no comforter for her. O LORD, behold my affliction, for the enemy has magnified [himself].

title: Lamentations 1:10
text: The enemy has spread out his hand upon all her desirable things; for she has seen the nations enter her holy place, whom You commanded that they should not enter into Your congregation.

title: Lamentations 1:11
text: All her people sigh; they seek bread. They have given their desirable things for food to relieve the soul. See, O LORD, and look on [me], for I have become vile.

title: Lamentations 1:12
text: [Is it] nothing to you, all you who pass by? Behold and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow which is done to me, with which the LORD has afflicted [me] in the day of His fierce anger.

title: Lamentations 1:13
text: From above He has sent fire into my bones and it has laid them low. He has spread a net for my feet; He has turned me back; He has made me amazed [and] faint all the day.

title: Lamentations 1:14
text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by His hand; they intertwine; they rise on my neck. He has made my strength to falter; the LORD has delivered me into [their] hands. I am not able to rise up.

title: Lamentations 1:15
text: The LORD has trampled all my mighty ones in my midst; He has called a gathering against me to crush my young men. The LORD has trod the virgin daughter of Judah, [as] in a winepress.

title: Lamentations 1:16
text: For these I weep; my eye, my eye runs down [with] water, because the comforter who could refresh my soul is far from me. My sons are desolated because the enemy prevails.

title: Lamentations 1:17
text: Zion spreads forth her hands; none [is] comforting to me; the LORD has commanded concerning Jacob that his enemies [should be] all around him; Jerusalem has become as an impure thing among them.

title: Lamentations 1:18
text: The LORD [is] righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. I beseech you, all peoples, hear and behold my sorrow. My virgins and my young men went into exile.

title: Lamentations 1:19
text: I called for my lovers, [but] they deceived me; my priests and my elders expired in the city while they sought food for them to bring back their life.

title: Lamentations 1:20
text: Behold, O LORD, for I [am] in trouble; my inward parts ferment; my heart is turned within me, for I have grievously rebelled. On the outside the sword bereaves; in the house [it is] as death.

title: Lamentations 1:21
text: They hear that I sigh; [there is] none to comfort me. All my enemies have heard my evil; they are glad that You have done [it]. You will bring the day [that] You have called, and they shall be like me.

title: Lamentations 1:22
text: Let all their wickedness come before You; and do to them as You have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs [are] many, and my heart [is] faint.

title: Lamentations 2:1
text: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in His anger! He cast down the beauty of Israel from the heavens to the earth and remembered not His footstool in the day of His anger.

title: Lamentations 2:2
text: The Lord swallowed up all the dwelling-places of Jacob [and] has not pitied. In His wrath He has thrown down the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought [them] down to the ground. He has defiled the kingdom and its rulers.

title: Lamentations 2:3
text: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in [His] fierce anger; He has drawn back His right hand from before the enemy, and He burned against Jacob like flaming fire [which] devours all around.

title: Lamentations 2:4
text: He has bent His bow like an enemy; [He stood with] His right hand like an adversary, and killed all [who were] desirable to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion. He poured out His fury like fire.

title: Lamentations 2:5
text: The LORD was like an enemy; He swallowed up Israel; He has swallowed up all her palaces, [and] destroyed His strongholds. And [He] has increased mourning and weeping in the daughter of Judah.

title: Lamentations 2:6
text: And He violated His booth like a garden, [and] destroyed His meeting places. The LORD caused the meeting places and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and He despised the king and the priest in the fury of His anger.

title: Lamentations 2:7
text: The LORD has cast off His altar; He rejected His sanctuary; He has given up the walls of her palaces into the hater's hand. They gave a noise in the house of the LORD, as a day of meeting.

title: Lamentations 2:8
text: The LORD purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; He has stretched out a line; He has not withdrawn His hand from swallowing, and He made rampart and wall lament; they languish together.

title: Lamentations 2:9
text: Her gates have sunk in the ground; He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her kings and her rulers [are] among the nations. The law is no more; also her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.

title: Lamentations 2:10
text: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground and [are] silent; they send up dust on their heads; they gird on sackclothes. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

title: Lamentations 2:11
text: My eyes fail with tears; my inward parts ferment; my liver is poured on the ground for the ruin of the daughter of my people, in that the children and the babies faint in the streets of the city.

title: Lamentations 2:12
text: They say to their mothers, Where [are] grain and wine? In their fainting [they are] like the wounded in the streets of the city, in their pouring out their lives to their mothers' bosom.

title: Lamentations 2:13
text: What can I testify for you? What thing shall I compare to you, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to you, so that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? For your break [is] great like the sea! Who can heal you?

title: Lamentations 2:14
text: Your prophets have seen false and foolish things for you, and they have not uncovered your iniquity, to turn away your captivity; but they have seen false oracles and seductions for you.

title: Lamentations 2:15
text: All who pass by clap [their] hands at you; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, [saying], Is this the city which they called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?

title: Lamentations 2:16
text: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you; they hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed [her] up. Certainly this [is] the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen.

title: Lamentations 2:17
text: The LORD has done [what] He has purposed; He has fulfilled His word which He commanded from the days of old. He has thrown down and not pitied. And He caused your hater to rejoice over you; He has set up the horn of your foes.

title: Lamentations 2:18
text: Their heart cried to the LORD. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a torrent day and night; give yourself no rest. Let not the daughter of your eye cease.

title: Lamentations 2:19
text: Arise, cry out in the night. At the beginning of the watches, pour out your heart like water before the face of the LORD. Lift up your hands toward Him for the life of your children who are faint for hunger in the head of every street.

title: Lamentations 2:20
text: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom You have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, children of tender care? Shall the priest and the prophet be killed in the holy place of the Lord?

title: Lamentations 2:21
text: Young and old lie on the ground in the streets; my virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed [them] in the day of Your anger; You have killed and not pitied.

title: Lamentations 2:22
text: You have called as in a solemn day my terrors all around, and here was not an escaped one or a survivor in the day of the LORD's anger. Those whom I have nursed and multiplied, my enemy has consumed.

title: Lamentations 3:1
text: I the man have seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.

title: Lamentations 3:2
text: He has led me and made [me] go in darkness and not into light.

title: Lamentations 3:3
text: Surely He turned [against me]; He turns His hand all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:4
text: He has wasted my flesh and my skin; He has broken my bones.

title: Lamentations 3:5
text: He built against me and has circled [me] with bitterness and hardship.

title: Lamentations 3:6
text: He has made me live in dark places, like the dead of old.

title: Lamentations 3:7
text: He has set a fence around me and I cannot go out; He has made my bronze [chain] heavy.

title: Lamentations 3:8
text: Also when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.

title: Lamentations 3:9
text: He walled up my ways with cut stone; my paths are crooked.

title: Lamentations 3:10
text: He [was] a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in secret places.

title: Lamentations 3:11
text: He has turned my ways aside and torn me in pieces. He made me desolate.

title: Lamentations 3:12
text: He has bent His bow and set me as a mark for the arrow.

title: Lamentations 3:13
text: He has caused the arrows of His quiver to enter into my inward parts.

title: Lamentations 3:14
text: I was a mockery to all my people, their song all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:15
text: He has filled me with bitterness [and] made me drunk [with] wormwood.

title: Lamentations 3:16
text: He also broke my teeth with gravel; He has covered me in the ashes.

title: Lamentations 3:17
text: And You cast off my soul from peace; I have forgotten blessedness.

title: Lamentations 3:18
text: And I said, My strength and my hope from the LORD [are] gone.

title: Lamentations 3:19
text: Remember my affliction and my wandering, [as] wormwood and bitterness.

title: Lamentations 3:20
text: My soul vividly remembers and bows down on me.

title: Lamentations 3:21
text: I recall this to my mind; therefore I hope.

title: Lamentations 3:22
text: [It is] by the LORD's kindnesses that we are not destroyed, because His mercies never fail.

title: Lamentations 3:23
text: [They are] new every morning; great [is] Your faithfulness.

title: Lamentations 3:24
text: The LORD [is] my portion, says my soul; therefore I will hope in Him.

title: Lamentations 3:25
text: The LORD [is] good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.

title: Lamentations 3:26
text: [It is] good that one should hope for the salvation of the LORD, even in silence.

title: Lamentations 3:27
text: [It is] good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

title: Lamentations 3:28
text: He sits alone and keeps silence because He laid [it] on him.

title: Lamentations 3:29
text: He puts his mouth in the dust, if perhaps there may be hope.

title: Lamentations 3:30
text: He gives [his] cheek to Him who strikes him; he is filled with reproach.

title: Lamentations 3:31
text: For the Lord will not cast off forever;

title: Lamentations 3:32
text: for though He causes grief, yet He will have pity according to the multitude of His kindnesses.

title: Lamentations 3:33
text: For He does not afflict from His heart, nor does He grieve the sons of men;

title: Lamentations 3:34
text: to crush all the prisoners of the earth under his feet;

title: Lamentations 3:35
text: to turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High;

title: Lamentations 3:36
text: to pervert a man in his cause-- [this] the LORD does not see.

title: Lamentations 3:37
text: Who [is] this [who] speaks, and it occurs, [when] the Lord does not command it?

title: Lamentations 3:38
text: From the mouth of the Most High does not go out the evil and the good.

title: Lamentations 3:39
text: What? Should mankind complain, a living man, because of his sins?

title: Lamentations 3:40
text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

title: Lamentations 3:41
text: Let us lift up our heart [and] hands to God in Heaven.

title: Lamentations 3:42
text: We have sinned and have rebelled; You have not forgiven.

title: Lamentations 3:43
text: You have wrapped Yourself with anger and pursued us; You have slain; You have not pitied.

title: Lamentations 3:44
text: You have wrapped Yourself with a cloud from [any] prayer passing through.

title: Lamentations 3:45
text: You have made us [as] the sweepings and garbage in the midst of the peoples.

title: Lamentations 3:46
text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

title: Lamentations 3:47
text: Fear and a pit have come to us, shame and ruin.

title: Lamentations 3:48
text: Streams of water run down my eye for the ruin of the daughter of my people.

title: Lamentations 3:49
text: My eye flows out and does not cease, from there being no intermission,

title: Lamentations 3:50
text: until the LORD shall look down and behold from Heaven.

title: Lamentations 3:51
text: My eye pains my soul because of all the daughters of my city.

title: Lamentations 3:52
text: My haters have hunted me, like a bird, without cause.

title: Lamentations 3:53
text: They have cut off my life in the pit, and cast a stone at me.

title: Lamentations 3:54
text: Waters flowed over my head; [then] I said, I am cut off.

title: Lamentations 3:55
text: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the lowest pit.

title: Lamentations 3:56
text: You have heard my voice; do not hide Your ear at my relief, at my cry for help.

title: Lamentations 3:57
text: You drew near in the day [that] I called on You; You said, Fear not.

title: Lamentations 3:58
text: O LORD, You strove for the causes of my soul; You redeemed my life.

title: Lamentations 3:59
text: O Lord, You have seen my wrong; judge my cause.

title: Lamentations 3:60
text: You have seen all their vengeance, all their plots against me.

title: Lamentations 3:61
text: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, all their plots against me;

title: Lamentations 3:62
text: the lips of those who rose up against me, and their scheming against me all the day.

title: Lamentations 3:63
text: Behold their sitting down and their rising up; I [am] their song.

title: Lamentations 3:64
text: You will return to them a recompense, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

title: Lamentations 3:65
text: You will give them dullness of heart, Your curse on them.

title: Lamentations 3:66
text: Pursue and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.

title: Lamentations 4:1
text: How the gold has become dim; the fine gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

title: Lamentations 4:2
text: The precious sons of Zion are weighed against pure gold; how they are counted as earthen vessels, the work of a potter's hand!

title: Lamentations 4:3
text: Even the jackals draw out the breast; they suckle their young ones. The daughter of my people [is] cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

title: Lamentations 4:4
text: The suckling's tongue cleaves to his palate in thirst; the young children ask bread; there is no breaking to them.

title: Lamentations 4:5
text: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets; those reared in scarlet embrace dunghills.

title: Lamentations 4:6
text: And the iniquity of the daughter of my people is heaped more than the sin of Sodom, overthrown as [in] a moment, and no hands spun on her.

title: Lamentations 4:7
text: Her Nazarites [were] purer than snow, whiter than milk; they [were] redder [of] bone than corals; their cuttings [as] lapis lazuli, [azure blue].

title: Lamentations 4:8
text: Their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets; their skin has shriveled on their bones; it is dried up; it has become like wood.

title: Lamentations 4:9
text: Better [are] the ones slain by the sword than the ones slain by hunger; those who pine away, pierced because the fruits of my fields [failed].

title: Lamentations 4:10
text: The hands of the pitying women have boiled their own children; they became their food in the ruin of the daughter of my people.

title: Lamentations 4:11
text: The LORD has fulfilled His fury; He has poured out His fierce anger, and has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has devoured its foundations.

title: Lamentations 4:12
text: The kings of the earth, and all the people of the world, would not have believed that the foe and the hater would go into Jerusalem's gates.

title: Lamentations 4:13
text: For the sins of her prophets [and] the iniquities of her priests, shedding the blood of the just in her midst,

title: Lamentations 4:14
text: they reeled blind in the streets; they are defiled with blood, so that not [any] can touch their clothes.

title: Lamentations 4:15
text: They cried to them, Depart! Unclean! Depart, depart! Touch not! Indeed they fled and reeled; they said among the nations, They will not continue to live [there].

title: Lamentations 4:16
text: The face of the LORD has shared them out; He will no longer look on them; they did not respect the persons of the priests; they did not favor the elders.

title: Lamentations 4:17
text: While we are, our eyes fail, for our help is vain; in our watching we have watched for a nation; it does not save.

title: Lamentations 4:18
text: They hunted our steps from going in our streets; our end was near, our days were fulfilled, for our end has come.

title: Lamentations 4:19
text: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens; they pursued us on the mountains, they lay in wait for us in the wilderness.

title: Lamentations 4:20
text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed [of] the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, In his shadow we shall live among the nations.

title: Lamentations 4:21
text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, who lives in the land of Uz. The cup also shall pass through unto you; you shall be drunken and stripped naked.

title: Lamentations 4:22
text: The punishment of your iniquity [is] fulfilled, O daughter of Zion; He will exile you no more. He will visit your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.

title: Lamentations 5:1
text: Remember, O LORD, what has been to us; look down and see our shame.

title: Lamentations 5:2
text: Our inheritance has turned to aliens, our houses to foreigners.

title: Lamentations 5:3
text: We are orphans and fatherless; our mothers [are] as widows.

title: Lamentations 5:4
text: We have drunk our water for silver; our wood comes for a price.

title: Lamentations 5:5
text: We [are] pursued on our necks; we grow weary; rest is not given to us.

title: Lamentations 5:6
text: We have given the hand [to] Egypt, to Assyria, to be satisfied with bread.

title: Lamentations 5:7
text: Our fathers have sinned [and are] not; we have borne their iniquities.

title: Lamentations 5:8
text: Servants rule over us; [there is] no rescuer out of their hand.

title: Lamentations 5:9
text: We bring in our bread with our souls, because of the sword of the wilderness.

title: Lamentations 5:10
text: Our skin [is] hot like an oven because of the fever heat of famine.

title: Lamentations 5:11
text: They raped the women in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.

title: Lamentations 5:12
text: Rulers were hanged by the hand; the faces of elders were not honored.

title: Lamentations 5:13
text: They took the young men [to] grind, and the youths stumbled at the wood.

title: Lamentations 5:14
text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.

title: Lamentations 5:15
text: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dance has turned into mourning.

title: Lamentations 5:16
text: The crown has fallen [from] our head. Woe now to us! For we have sinned.

title: Lamentations 5:17
text: Our heart is faint for this; our eyes are dim for these [things].

title: Lamentations 5:18
text: On the mountain of Zion [is] laid waste, the foxes walk on it.

title: Lamentations 5:19
text: You, O LORD, remain forever; Your throne to generation and generation.

title: Lamentations 5:20
text: Why do You forget us forever [and] forsake us the length of days?

title: Lamentations 5:21
text: Return us to You, O LORD, and we will turn; renew our days as of old,

title: Lamentations 5:22
text: unless You have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.

title: Ezekiel 1:1
text: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

title: Ezekiel 1:2
text: On the fifth of the month, the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

title: Ezekiel 1:3
text: the word of the LORD coming became the word of the LORD to Ezekiel, the son of Buzi, the priest in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar. And the hand of the LORD was on him there.

title: Ezekiel 1:4
text: And I looked, and behold, a windstorm came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire flashing itself, and a brightness to it all around, and out of its midst, like the color of polished bronze out of the middle of the fire.

title: Ezekiel 1:5
text: Also out of its midst [came] the likeness of four living creatures. And this [was] how they looked; they had the likeness of a man.

title: Ezekiel 1:6
text: And four faces [were] to each, and four wings to each.

title: Ezekiel 1:7
text: And their feet [were] straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot. And they sparkled like the color of burnished copper.

title: Ezekiel 1:8
text: And the [hands] of a man [extended] from under their wings on their four sides; and the four of them [had] their faces and their wings,

title: Ezekiel 1:9
text: joining each one to the other [by] their wings. They did not turn in their going; each one went toward the front of their face.

title: Ezekiel 1:10
text: And the likeness of their faces: the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right [side] to the four of them; and the face of an ox on the left side to the four of them; and the face of an eagle to the four of them.

title: Ezekiel 1:11
text: So their faces [were]. And their wings [were] stretched upward; to each, the two [wings] of each one were joined; and two [wings] covered their bodies.

title: Ezekiel 1:12
text: And each went toward the front of their faces. To where the spirit was to go, there they went; they did not turn in their going.

title: Ezekiel 1:13
text: And the likeness of the living creatures: they looked like burning coals of fire; like the appearance of torches. It was continually circling among the living creatures. And the fire [was] bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

title: Ezekiel 1:14
text: And the living creatures kept running and returning, like the appearance of a flash of lightning.

title: Ezekiel 1:15
text: And as I looked at the living creatures, behold, one wheel [was] on the earth by the living creatures, with its four faces.

title: Ezekiel 1:16
text: The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship [was] the color of beryl, and the four of them had one likeness. And their appearance and their workmanship [was] like a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

title: Ezekiel 1:17
text: When they went, they went on their four sides; [and] they did not turn when they went.

title: Ezekiel 1:18
text: And their rims: they [were] even high; they were even awesome. And their rims [were] full of eyes all around the four of them.

title: Ezekiel 1:19
text: And in the going of the living creatures, the wheels went beside them; and in the lifting up of the living creatures from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

title: Ezekiel 1:20
text: Wherever the spirit was to go, there they went; there the spirit [was] to go, and the wheels were lifted up along with them. For the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 1:21
text: In their going, [these] went; and in their standing still, these stood still. And in their lifting up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up along with them. For the spirit of the living creature [was] in the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 1:22
text: And there [was] a likeness over the heads of the living creature; an expanse, like the color of awesome crystal stretched out over their heads from above.

title: Ezekiel 1:23
text: And under the expanse their wings [were] straight, the one toward the other. Each one had two [wings] covering on this [side], and to each two covering on that [side of] their bodies.

title: Ezekiel 1:24
text: And I heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, in their going [was] the sound of tumult, like the sound of an army. In their standing still, they let down their wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:25
text: And there was a voice from the expanse which [was] over their heads, in their standing still, and they let down their wings.

title: Ezekiel 1:26
text: And from above the expanse that [was] over their heads [was] a likeness like a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne. And on the likeness of the throne [was] a likeness looking like a man on it from above.

title: Ezekiel 1:27
text: And I saw [Him] looking like the color of polished bronze, looking like fire all around within it. From the likeness of His loins even upward, and from the likeness of His loins even downward, I saw [Him], looking like fire, and it had brightness all around.

title: Ezekiel 1:28
text: As the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain looks, so the brightness all around looked. This was how the likeness of the glory of the LORD looked. And I saw. And I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of One speaking.

title: Ezekiel 2:1
text: And He said to me, Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.

title: Ezekiel 2:2
text: And the Spirit entered into me when He spoke to me, and set me on my feet, so that I heard Him who spoke to me.

title: Ezekiel 2:3
text: And He said to me, Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to the nations, the rebelling ones who have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have sinned against Me, to this day.

title: Ezekiel 2:4
text: And the sons [are] stiff of face, and hard of heart. I am sending you to them; and you shall say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 2:5
text: And they, whether they will hear or whether they will forbear; for they [are] a rebellious house. Yea, they shall know that there has been a prophet among them.

title: Ezekiel 2:6
text: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them, and of their words, though briers and thorns [are] with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words, nor frightened by their faces, though they [are] a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 2:7
text: And you shall speak My words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will forbear, for they [are] rebellious.

title: Ezekiel 2:8
text: But you, son of man, hear what I am saying to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I am giving you.

title: Ezekiel 2:9
text: And I looked, and behold! A hand [was] extended to me; and lo, a roll of a book [was] in it.

title: Ezekiel 2:10
text: And He spread it before me; and it [was] written on the face and the back. And written on it [were] weepings, and mourning, and woe.

title: Ezekiel 3:1
text: And He said to me, Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this roll, and go speak to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 3:2
text: So I opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat that roll.

title: Ezekiel 3:3
text: And He said to me, Son of man, cause your belly to eat, and fill your belly with this roll that I give you. Then I ate [it]; and in my mouth it was like honey for sweetness.

title: Ezekiel 3:4
text: And He said to me, Son of man, go! Go up to the house of Israel and speak to them with My words.

title: Ezekiel 3:5
text: For you [are] not sent to a people of a deep lip and of a difficult language, [but] to the house of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 3:6
text: not to many people of a deep lip and of a difficult language, whose words you cannot hear. Surely, if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

title: Ezekiel 3:7
text: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to Me; for all the house of Israel [are] strong of forehead and hard of heart.

title: Ezekiel 3:8
text: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces and your forehead strong against their foreheads.

title: Ezekiel 3:9
text: I have made your forehead as an adamant harder than flint. Do not be bowed down by their faces, though they [are] a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 3:10
text: And He said to me, Son of man, receive all My words which I shall speak to you in your heart, and hear with your ears.

title: Ezekiel 3:11
text: And go! Go to those of the captivity, to the sons of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, So says the Lord God; whether they will hear or whether they will forbear.

title: Ezekiel 3:12
text: And the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a sound of a great rushing, [saying], Blessed [be] the glory of the LORD from His place.

title: Ezekiel 3:13
text: [I] also [heard] the sound of the wings of the living creatures touching one another, and the sound of the wheels along with them, and a sound of a great rushing.

title: Ezekiel 3:14
text: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong on me.

title: Ezekiel 3:15
text: Then I came to the exiles at Tel-at-abib, who lived by the river Chebar. And I sat [where] they sat; and I also dwelt seven days, being stricken dumb among them.

title: Ezekiel 3:16
text: And it happened at the end of seven days, even it happened [that] the word of the LORD [came] to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 3:17
text: Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word of My mouth, and give them warning from Me.

title: Ezekiel 3:18
text: When I say to the wicked, You shall surely die; and you do not give him warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked one shall die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

title: Ezekiel 3:19
text: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.

title: Ezekiel 3:20
text: And when the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and when I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die. Because you have not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require at your hand.

title: Ezekiel 3:21
text: But if you warn the righteous so that the righteous does not sin, and if he does not sin, he shall surely live because he is warned; also you have delivered your soul.

title: Ezekiel 3:22
text: And the hand of the LORD was on me there. And He said to me, Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.

title: Ezekiel 3:23
text: Then I arose and went out into the plain; and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. And I fell on my face.

title: Ezekiel 3:24
text: And the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet; and spoke with me, and said to me, Go, shut yourself inside your house!

title: Ezekiel 3:25
text: But you, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands on you and shall bind you with them, and you shall not go out among them.

title: Ezekiel 3:26
text: And I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be dumb and shall not be one who warns them. For they [are] a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 3:27
text: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, So says the Lord God: He who hears, let him hear; and he who stops his ears, let him stop; for they [are] a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 4:1
text: And you, son of man, take a tile to yourself, and lay it before you, and portray on it the city Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 4:2
text: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mound against it. Also set the camp against it, and set [battering] rams against it all around.

title: Ezekiel 4:3
text: And take an iron griddle to yourself, and set it [for] a wall of iron between you and the city. And set your face against it, and it shall be under attack. And you shall set a battle against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 4:4
text: Also lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it; [according] to the number of days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 4:5
text: For I have laid on you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 4:6
text: And when you have fulfilled them, lie again on your right side, and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days; a day for a year; a day for a year, I have set for you.

title: Ezekiel 4:7
text: And you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and your arm [shall be] uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.

title: Ezekiel 4:8
text: And, behold, I will lay bands on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to [another] until you have ended the days of your siege.

title: Ezekiel 4:9
text: Take also to yourself wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel, and make bread of them for yourself. [According] to the number of the days that you shall lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days, you shall eat of it.

title: Ezekiel 4:10
text: And your food which you shall eat [shall be] by weight twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat it.

title: Ezekiel 4:11
text: You shall also drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

title: Ezekiel 4:12
text: And you shall eat it [as] barley cakes, and you shall bake it with dung of the excrement of man, in their sight.

title: Ezekiel 4:13
text: And the LORD said, Even so shall the sons of Israel eat their defiled bread among the nations, where I will drive them.

title: Ezekiel 4:14
text: Then I said, Ah Lord God! Behold, my soul has not been defiled. For from my youth up, even till now, I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither did there come any unclean flesh into my mouth.

title: Ezekiel 4:15
text: Then He said to me, Lo, I have given you cow's dung for man's dung, and you shall prepare your bread with it.

title: Ezekiel 4:16
text: And He said to me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. And they shall eat bread by weight, and with care. And they shall drink water by measure, and in silence,

title: Ezekiel 4:17
text: so that they may lack bread and water, and be stricken dumb with one another, and waste away in their iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 5:1
text: And you, son of man, take a sharp sword to yourself, take a barber's razor also, and cause [it] to pass on your head and on your beard. Then take scales to weigh, and divide the [hair].

title: Ezekiel 5:2
text: You shall burn a third part with fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled; and you shall take a third part [and] beat around it with a sword; and you shall scatter a third part in the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 5:3
text: Also you shall take a few of them in number, and tie them up in your skirts.

title: Ezekiel 5:4
text: Then take of them again, and throw them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for a fire shall come forth from them into all the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 5:5
text: So says the Lord God: This [is] Jerusalem. I have set it in the middle of the nations, and all around her [are] the lands.

title: Ezekiel 5:6
text: And she has changed My judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and [defiled] My laws more than the countries that [are] all around her; for they have rejected My judgments and My laws; they have not walked in them.

title: Ezekiel 5:7
text: Therefore so says the Lord God: Because you multiplied more than the nations that [are] all around you, [and] have not walked in My laws, neither have kept My judgments, nor have done according to the judgments of the nations all around you;

title: Ezekiel 5:8
text: therefore so says the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, [am] against you, and will carry out judgments in your midst before the nations.

title: Ezekiel 5:9
text: And I will do in you that which I have not done, and the like of which I will never do again, because of all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 5:10
text: So the fathers shall eat the sons in your midst, and the sons shall eat their fathers. And I will execute judgments in you, and I will scatter the whole remnant of you into all the winds.

title: Ezekiel 5:11
text: Therefore, [as] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also withdraw; nor shall My eye spare you, nor will I have any pity.

title: Ezekiel 5:12
text: A third part of you shall die with the plague, and shall be consumed with the famine in your midst. And a third part shall fall by the sword all around you; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 5:13
text: So My anger shall be fulfilled, and I will cause My fury to rest on them, and I will be comforted. And they shall know that I the LORD have spoken [it] in My zeal, when I have fulfilled My fury in them.

title: Ezekiel 5:14
text: And I will make you a waste and a curse among the nations that [are] all around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

title: Ezekiel 5:15
text: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an example and a wonder to the nations which [are] all around you, when I shall execute judgments against you in anger and in fury and in rebukes [among them]. I the LORD have spoken it.

title: Ezekiel 5:16
text: When I shall send on them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for [their] ruin, which I will send to destroy you; even I will increase the famine on you, and break your staff of bread;

title: Ezekiel 5:17
text: yea, I will send on you famine and evil beasts, and you will be bereaved. And pestilence and blood shall pass among you; and I shall bring a sword on you. I the LORD have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 6:1
text: And it happened, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 6:2
text: Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

title: Ezekiel 6:3
text: And say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God. So says the Lord Jehovah to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

title: Ezekiel 6:4
text: And your altars shall be wasted, and your pillars shall be broken. And I will make fall your slain before your idols.

title: Ezekiel 6:5
text: And I will put the dead bodies of the sons of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

title: Ezekiel 6:6
text: In all the places where you live, cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be deserted; so that your altars may be laid waste and become guilty, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your pillars may be cut down, and your works wiped out.

title: Ezekiel 6:7
text: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 6:8
text: Yet I will leave a reminder that may be [left] to you [some] who escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the lands.

title: Ezekiel 6:9
text: And those of you who escape shall remember Me among the nations where they shall be exiled, because I was broken [by] their whoring heart which has departed from Me, and with their whoring eyes which go after their idols. And they shall despise themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

title: Ezekiel 6:10
text: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, [and that] I have not said in vain to do this evil to them.

title: Ezekiel 6:11
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Strike with your hand and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas, for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! For they shall fall by the sword, and by the famine, and by the plague.

title: Ezekiel 6:12
text: He who is afar off shall die of the plague; and he who is near shall fall by the sword; and he who remains and is under siege shall die by the famine. So I will fulfill My fury on them.

title: Ezekiel 6:13
text: Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD, when their dead shall be among their idols all around their altars, on every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every leafy oak, the place where they offered sweet aroma to all their idols.

title: Ezekiel 6:14
text: And I will stretch out My hand on them and make the land a waste, even more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all the places where they live; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 7:1
text: And it happened, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 7:2
text: And you, son of man, so says the Lord Jehovah to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

title: Ezekiel 7:3
text: Now the end [is] on you, and I will send My anger on you and will judge you according to your ways, and will lay on you all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 7:4
text: And My eye shall not spare you, neither will I have pity. But I will repay your ways on you, and your abominations shall be in your midst; and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 7:5
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: An evil: Behold, an only evil has come!

title: Ezekiel 7:6
text: An end has come, the end has come. It awakes against you; behold, it has come.

title: Ezekiel 7:7
text: The encirclement has come to you, O dwellers of the land. The time has come, the day of tumult [is] near, and not a shout of the mountains.

title: Ezekiel 7:8
text: And I will soon pour out My fury on you, and fulfill My anger on you. And I will judge you according to your ways, and will repay you for all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 7:9
text: And My eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; I will repay you according to your ways and your abominations [that] are in your midst. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD who strikes.

title: Ezekiel 7:10
text: Behold the day! Behold, it has come; the encirclement has gone out; the rod has blossomed; pride has budded.

title: Ezekiel 7:11
text: Violence has risen up for a rod of wickedness. None of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of any of their riches; nor [shall] there [be] wailing for them.

title: Ezekiel 7:12
text: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath [is] on all her multitude.

title: Ezekiel 7:13
text: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision to all her multitude shall not return, and a man shall not hold his life strong in iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 7:14
text: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goes to the battle, for My wrath [is] on all her multitude.

title: Ezekiel 7:15
text: The sword [is] outside, and the plague and the famine inside. He who [is] in the field shall die with the sword; and he in the city shall be devoured by famine and plague.

title: Ezekiel 7:16
text: But [if] their fugitives shall escape, then they shall be like doves of the valleys on the mountains, all of them mourning, each one for his iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 7:17
text: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall go [weak as] water.

title: Ezekiel 7:18
text: They shall also gird [on] sackcloth, and trembling shall cover them; and shame [shall be] on all faces, and baldness on all heads.

title: Ezekiel 7:19
text: They shall throw their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be an impure thing. Their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because their iniquity has become a stumbling-block for them.

title: Ezekiel 7:20
text: And the beauty of His ornament, He set it in majesty. But they made the images of their abominations [and] of their hateful things in it; therefore I have put it to them as an impure thing.

title: Ezekiel 7:21
text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prize, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall defile it.

title: Ezekiel 7:22
text: I will also turn My face from them, and they shall defile My secret [place]; and violent ones shall enter into it and defile it.

title: Ezekiel 7:23
text: Make a chain; for the land is full of bloody judgments, and the city is full of violence.

title: Ezekiel 7:24
text: And I will bring the most evil of the nations, and they shall possess their houses. I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

title: Ezekiel 7:25
text: Ruin comes; and they shall seek peace, but none [shall be].

title: Ezekiel 7:26
text: Disaster on disaster shall come, and rumor to rumor shall be. And they shall seek a vision from the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and wisdom from the elders.

title: Ezekiel 7:27
text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled. I will do to them according to their way, and according to their judgments I will judge them; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 8:1
text: And it was in the sixth year, in the sixth [month], on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me. And the hand of the Lord Jehovah fell on me there.

title: Ezekiel 8:2
text: And I looked, and behold! A likeness as the look of fire; from the appearance of His loins and downward, [like] fire. And from his loins and upward as the look of brightness, like the color of polished bronze.

title: Ezekiel 8:3
text: And He put out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head. And the Spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heavens, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the opening of the inner gate facing north, where there [was] a seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

title: Ezekiel 8:4
text: And, behold! The glory of the God of Israel [was] there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

title: Ezekiel 8:5
text: And He said to me, Son of man, lift up your eyes now to the way of the north. So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and behold, northward at the gate of the altar the image of jealousy [was] at the entrance.

title: Ezekiel 8:6
text: And He said to me, Son of man, do you see what they do; even the great abominations which the house of Israel is doing here, that I should go far off from My sanctuary? But turn again, [and] you shall see greater abominations.

title: Ezekiel 8:7
text: And He brought me to the opening of the court; and I looked, and behold, a hole in the wall.

title: Ezekiel 8:8
text: And He said to me, Son of man, dig in the wall now. And I dug in the wall, and, behold, an opening.

title: Ezekiel 8:9
text: And he said to me. Go in and see the evil abominations that they do here.

title: Ezekiel 8:10
text: And I went in and saw. And behold, every kind of creeping thing, and hateful beast, and all the idols of the house of Israel, were carved on the wall all around.

title: Ezekiel 8:11
text: And seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, standing among them, these were before them, and each man with his censor in his hand. And the odor of the cloud of incense was rising.

title: Ezekiel 8:12
text: And He said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, each man in his image room? For they are saying, The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the earth.
